blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Bashkir is a low-resource agglutinative language written in Cyrillic and remains poorly represented in modern LLMs. We present an open resource suite and a systematic benchmark of adaptation methods: the Bashkir Web Corpus (71,567 documents, 46.9M tokens, 16 sources) and three labelled datasets for binary, multiclass and multilabel text classification; the benchmark covers the first two. Experiments use eight architectures (82M-8B: DistilGPT2, GPT-2 base/medium, Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, mBERT, XLM-R) and three adaptation groups (full fine-tuning, QLoRA, in-context learning), plus continual pretraining (CPT). (1) QLoRA on 3.8-8B models outperforms encoder-only fine-tuning on binary classification: YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B with CPT reaches macro-F1 0.748 vs 0.653 (XLM-R) and 0.650 (mBERT); pairwise differences are significant after Holm correction (p<0.001). (2) YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B significantly outperforms Mistral-7B and Phi-3-mini on multiclass classification, BPB and native-speaker ratings (mean 3.28 vs 2.52 and 2.22; n=100; alpha=0.69-0.77; p<0.05); on binary classification its QLoRA advantage is not significant (p>=0.084). (3) CPT effects depend on model and task: perplexity improves for Phi-3-mini (+0.58) and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (+0.33) but worsens for Mistral-7B (-1.15, p<0.001); on binary classification CPT helps Mistral-7B most (+4.0 macro-F1). (4) Tokeniser fertility on Bashkir varies 2.67x (2.92-7.80) and tracks adaptation quality, while perplexity across tokenisers is not comparable. Cyrillic tokenisers with Russian pretraining are preferable; LLM judges reproduce native ratings for grammar and coherence (rho=0.33-0.46) but not language correctness (rho=0.16, p=0.11); native evaluation remains necessary. All artefacts are open-licensed.
blocks.zh: 巴什基尔语(Bashkir)是一种用西里尔语书写的低资源杂质语言,在现代LLMs中仍然代表性差. 我们提出了一个开放的资源套件和适应方法的系统基准:Bashkir Web Corpus(71 567份文件,46.9M令牌,16个来源)和三套标签数据集,用于二进制、多类和多标签文本分类;基准涵盖前两个。 实验采用8个架构(82M-8B:DistilGPT2,GPT-2基/中,Phi-3-mini,Mistral-7B,YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B,mBERT,XLM-R)和3个适应组(全微调,QLORA,内文学习),外加持续预训(CPT). (1)3.8-8B型号上的QLORA在二进制分类上仅优于编码器的微调:带有CPT的YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B达到宏F1 0.748对0.653(XLM-R)和0.650(mBERT);在Holm校正(p<0.001)后,成对差异相当大. (2) YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B在多类分类,BPB和本地语的评分(平均3.28对2.52和2.22;n=100;alpha=0.69-0.77;p<0.05)上明显优于Mistral-7B和Phi-3-mini;在二进制分类上其QLORA的优势并不显著(p>=0.084). (3)CPT效应取决于模型和任务:Phi-3-mini(+0.58)和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(+0.33)的复杂度提高,但Mistral-7B(-1.15,p<0.01)的复杂度则恶化;关于二进制分类,CPT帮助Mistral-7B(+4.0宏-F1)最多. (4) Bashkir的Tokeniser生育率为2.67x(2.92-7.80),并跟踪适应质量,而不同标志剂之间的复杂程度是无法比较的。 带有俄语预训的西里尔语代词器更为可取;LLM法官对语法和一致性进行复制(rho=0.33-0.46),但不进行语言正确性(rho=0.16,p=0.11);本土评价仍有必要. 所有艺术品都持有开放许可证。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Bashkir belongs to the Turkic language family and is one of the state languages of the Republic of Bashkortostan. Despite this, Bashkir has an extremely limited digital presence: the volume of machine-readable texts, annotated corpora and pretrained language models is substantially smaller than for languages with a high digital presence and than for a number of closely related Turkic languages.
blocks.zh: 巴什基尔属于突厥语系,是巴什科尔托斯坦共和国的国语之一. 尽管如此,巴什基尔的数码存在极为有限:机器可读文本的量,注解的corpora和预训语言模型大大小于数字存在高的语言以及一些密切相关的突厥语.

blocks.en: Over the past few years, large language models have made a qualitative leap: growth in the number of parameters, the transition to instruction tuning, the emergence of parameter-efficient adaptation methods and open models have made large language models the main instrument of natural language processing (2026) ; Burnashev et al. (2026) . This development, however, is unevenly distributed across languages. The overwhelming majority of modern models are trained on English, which leads to digital inequality: languages with a limited digital presence — including Bashkir — are effectively excluded from the ecosystem of modern language technologies.
blocks.zh: 在过去几年中,大型语言模型实现了质的飞跃:参数数的增长,向教学调理的过渡,参数高效的适应方法和开放模型的出现使得大型语言模型成为自然语言处理的主要工具(2026年);Burnashev等人(2026年). 然而,这种发展在各语文之间分布不均。 绝大多数现代模式都接受过英语培训,这导致了数字不平等:包括巴什基尔在内的数字存在有限的语言实际上被排除在现代语言技术的生态系统之外.

blocks.en: This inequality manifests itself at three levels. First, tokenisers of multilingual models fragment agglutinative word forms into excessively long subsequences of subtokens, which reduces processing quality Eyupoglu (2019) ; Grechachin (2018) . Second, the absence of large open corpora limits the possibilities of both pretraining from scratch and continual training Khudiakova (2025) . Third, existing linguistic resources for Bashkir were created within a paradigm oriented towards search and aggregation of data rather than machine learning Sirazitdinov (2025) .
blocks.zh: 这种不平等表现在三个层面。 首先,多语种模型的象征物将繁体字形式片断,形成太长的子序列的子序列,这降低了加工质量Eyupoglu(2019年);Grechachin(2018年). 第二,没有大型露天公司限制了从头到尾进行预训和继续培训(2025年)的可能性。 第三,Bashkir的现有语言资源是在以搜索和汇总数据而不是机器学习Sirazitdinov(2025年)为导向的范式中创造的。

blocks.en: The digitisation of the Bashkir language began in the 2000s and is associated primarily with the creation of the Machine Fund of the Bashkir Language — an integrated information system developed at the Institute of History, Language and Literature, Ufa Federal Research Centre, Russian Academy of Sciences (IIL UFRC RAS) since 2006 Sirazitdinov and Buskunbaeva (2010) ; Sirazitdinov (2025) . The structure of the Fund includes a general word list, lexicographic, grammatical and experimental-phonetic databases, catalogues of manuscript and early printed books, a dialectological database, and corpus databases of prose, journalistic and folklore texts Sirazitdinov (2025) . The total number of linguistic data databases exceeds 75. These resources became the basis for subsequent corpus and applied developments Sirazitdinov (2024) .
blocks.zh: 巴什基尔语的数字化始于2000年代,主要与建立巴什基尔语机器基金有关——自2006年起,俄罗斯科学院乌法联邦研究中心(IIL UFRC RAS)在历史,语言和文学研究所开发的综合信息系统,Sirazitdinov和Buskunbaeva(2010);Sirazitdinov (2025). 基金的结构包括一个通用词表、词典、语法和实验语言数据库、手稿和早期印刷书籍目录、一个方言学数据库,以及流言、新闻和民俗文字数据库(2025年)。 语言数据数据库总数超过75个. 这些资源成为后续程序的基础,并应用了Sirazitdinov(2024年)的发展。

blocks.en: However, the architecture of the Machine Fund, developed on the basis of the Oracle relational database management system, is oriented towards search and aggregation of linguistic information and is not intended for training neural network models. The resulting gap between accumulated linguistic data and modern machine-learning methods determined the need to create open corpora suitable for pretraining and fine-tuning transformer architectures.
blocks.zh: 然而,基于甲骨文关系数据库管理系统开发的机器基金架构则面向语言信息的搜索和汇总,并非用于培训神经网络模型. 由此产生的累积语言数据和现代机器学习方法之间的差距决定了创建适合预训和微调变压器架构的开放型公司的需求.

blocks.en: In parallel, a strand emerged in Turkic studies concerned with the application of natural language processing methods to low-resource languages. Studies show that transfer of knowledge from closely related languages, multilingual training and parameter-efficient fine-tuning make it possible to achieve acceptable quality even with limited data volumes Saykhunov and Suleymanov (2019) ; Khusainov and Suleymanov (2021) ; Mirzakhalov et al. (2021) ; Gatiatullin et al. (2024) ; Suleymanov et al. (2026) . At the same time, until recently there were no systematic studies for Bashkir comparing different strategies for adapting large language models.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,突厥语研究中出现了关于将自然语言处理方法应用于低资源语言的分支。 研究表明,从密切相关的语言进行知识转让、多语种培训和参数效率高的微调,即使数据量有限,Saykhunov和Suleymanov(2019年)、Khusainov和Suleymanov(2021年)、Mirzakhalov等人(2021年)、Gatiatullin等人(2024年)、Suleymanov等人(2026年)也有可能达到可接受的质量。 同时,直到最近,巴什基尔还没有系统的研究来比较不同策略来适应大型语言模型.

blocks.en: The relevance of this work is determined by three factors. First, Bashkir remains a low-resource language, and existing open corpora have a limited volume and source imbalance Khudiakova (2025) . Second, parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods that have proved themselves in other languages (2026) ; Burnashev et al. (2026) ; Arabov et al. (2026c) have not been systematically tested on Bashkir material. Third, practical applications — machine translation Karpov (2026) ; Maxim (2026) ; Tyurin (2026) , speech recognition and synthesis Radford et al. (2022) ; Orel et al. (2023) ; Bekarystankyzy et al. (2024) , text classification Smetanina et al. (2020) ; Arabov et al. (2026c) ; Arabov et al. (2026a) — require reproducible benchmarks and open datasets, which remain insufficient for Bashkir.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的相关性由三个因素决定。 首先,巴什基尔语仍属低资源语言,现有的开放型公司(Open Corpora)体积有限,来源不平衡的Khudiakova(2025年). 第二,其他语言(2026年)证明了自己的参数效率微调方法;Burnashev等人(2026年);Arabov等人(2026年c)尚未在Bashkir材料上进行系统测试. 第三,实际应用——机器翻译卡尔波夫(2026),马克西姆(2026),蒂尤林(2026),语音识别和合成拉德福德等人(2022),奥雷尔等人(2023),别卡里斯坦基齐等人(2024),文本分类斯梅塔尼纳等人(2020),阿拉波夫等人(2026c),阿拉波夫等人(2026a)——需要可复制的基准和开放数据集,这对于巴什基尔来说仍然不足.

blocks.en: This study aims to fill this gap. The work presents three groups of artefacts and results. The first group is resources: the open Bashkir Web Corpus with 46.9 million tokens, as well as three annotated datasets for binary, multiclass and multilabel classification. The second group is empirical results: the application of QLoRA to medium-scale generative models, an assessment of continual pretraining on the Bashkir corpus as a preliminary stage before downstream adaptation, a comparison of in-context learning strategies (zero-shot and few-shot) with parameter updates, and full fine-tuning of small architectures as a baseline. The third group is analysis: measurement of tokeniser fertility and validation of LLM judges against ratings by native Bashkir speakers. Experiments were conducted on eight large language model architectures in the range from 82M to 8B parameters: three small models of the GPT-2 family (DistilGPT2, GPT-2 base, GPT-2 medium), three medium-scale generative models (Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B) and two encoder-only baselines (mBERT, XLM-R). All artefacts — experiment code, preprocessing scripts, trained adapters and the corpus itself — are released under open licences to ensure reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 这项研究旨在填补这一空白。 这项工作提出了三组手工艺品和成果。 第一组是资源:开放的Bashkir Web Corpus,4,690万令牌,以及三套附加说明的二进制,多类和多标签分类的数据集. 第二组是经验成果:将QLORA应用到中等规模的基因模型中,在下游适应前作为初步阶段对巴什基尔体学的持续预训进行评估,将文字内学习战略(零镜头和几镜头)与参数更新进行比较,以及将小架构进行全面微调作为基线. 第三组是分析:对照土著巴什基尔语演讲者的评分,衡量象征性生育率和验证LLM法官。 在82M到8B参数范围内的8个大语言模型架构上进行了实验:GPT-2家族的3个小模型(DistilGPT2,GPT-2基础,GPT-2介质),3个中尺度的基因模型(Phi-3-mini,Mistral-7B,YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B)和2个只编码器的基线(mPERT,XLM-R). 所有手工艺品——实验代码、预处理脚本、训练有素的适配器和装具本身——都根据开放许可证发放,以确保可复制。

blocks.en: The study addresses four research questions. RQ1: How does QLoRA adaptation of generative models of 3 , 8 3{,}8 – 8 8 B compare with full fine-tuning of encoder-only baselines (mBERT, XLM-R) on Bashkir text classification tasks? RQ2: Does continual pretraining on the Bashkir corpus produce a measurable gain in perplexity and downstream quality relative to QLoRA without CPT, and is the effect the same for different base models? RQ3: How is tokeniser fertility related to adaptation quality, and does it explain the gap between models with a Cyrillic vocabulary and a BPE vocabulary? RQ4: Do LLM judges reproduce the ratings of native Bashkir speakers, and which generation quality criteria remain inaccessible to automatic evaluation?
blocks.zh: 该研究涉及四个研究问题。 RQ1:与巴什基尔文本分类任务的编码器唯一基准(mBERT,XLM-R)的全微调相比,QLORA如何对3,8 3{,}8 – 8 B的基因模型进行调整? RQ2:对巴什基尔体的持续预训,相对于没有欧洲防止酷刑和不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚的QLORA而言,是否在复杂性和下游质量方面产生可衡量的收益,对不同基模型的影响是否相同? RQ3 : (中文(简体) ). 象征性的生育力如何与适应质量相关,它是否解释了具有西里尔语词汇和BPE词汇的模型之间的差距? RQ4:LLM评委是否转载本地巴什基尔语的评分,哪些生成质量标准仍然无法自动评价?.

blocks.en: The work is organised as follows. Section 2 contains a review of the literature on the digitisation of the Bashkir language, corpus linguistics, the morphology of agglutinative languages, PEFT and the application of PEFT to Turkic languages. Section 3 describes the corpus, datasets, models, adaptation strategies, hyperparameters and metrics. Section 4 presents results on language modelling, continual pretraining, binary and multiclass classification, in-context learning, generation quality and tokeniser analysis. Section 5 discusses the factors behind the superiority of YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, the selective effect of CPT, the divergence between LLM judges and native speakers, the role of tokenisation and practical recommendations. Section 6 formulates limitations, and Section 7 concludes and outlines directions for further work.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的安排如下。 第2节载有对巴什基尔语数字化、实体语言学、卵形语言形态学、PEFT以及PEFT对突厥语的应用等文献的审查。 第3节说明生物体、数据集、模型、适应战略、超参数和度量衡。 第4节介绍了语言建模、持续预训、二进制和多类分类、内文学习、生成质量和象征性分析等方面的成果。 第5节讨论了YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B的优越性背后的因素、欧洲防止酷刑委员会选择性的影响、LLM法官和母语者之间的分歧、象征性作用和实际建议。 第6节规定了限制,第7节总结并概述了今后工作的方向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Digitisation of the Bashkir Language and the Formation of Linguistic Resources
blocks.zh: 2.1 巴什基尔语的数字化和语言资源的形成

blocks.en: The first works describing the process of digitising the Bashkir language date from the early 2010s. The article Sirazitdinov and Buskunbaeva (2010) describes in detail the experience of creating national font layouts, the integration of the Bashkir language into operating systems together with Microsoft, and the conceptual foundations and launch of the information system “Machine Fund of the Bashkir Language”. For modern natural language processing, this work is a historical and methodological source explaining the origin and initial architecture of the main linguistic resource.
blocks.zh: 最早描述巴什基尔语数字化过程的作品可以追溯到2010年代初. 文章Sirazitdinov和Buskunbaeva(2010年)详细描述了创建国家字体布局的经验,将Bashkir语言与微软一起纳入操作系统,以及信息系统“Bashkir语言的Machine Fund”的概念基础和启动情况。 对于现代自然语言处理,本作是解释主要语言资源起源和初始架构的历史和方法学来源.

blocks.en: A generalising article is Khisamitdinova (2016) , which summarises the development of Bashkir philology in the post-Soviet period. Particular attention is paid to the creation of the ten-volume “Academic Dictionary of the Bashkir Language” and the conversion of its dictionary databases into digital format — the creation of electronic glossaries and terminological data banks. These lexicographic developments subsequently became the basis for building morphological analysers and automatic dictionaries.
blocks.zh: Khisamitdinova(2016年)总结了后苏联时期巴什基尔哲学的发展。 特别注意制作十卷本的《巴什基尔语言学术词典》,并将其词典数据库转换为数字格式——建立电子词汇和术语数据库。 这些词典发展后来成为建立形态分析仪和自动词典的基础.

blocks.en: The most complete description of the structure and functional capabilities of the Machine Fund is presented in Sirazitdinov (2025) . The author describes the organisation of ten large sections of the Fund (general word list, lexicographic, grammatical, experimental-phonetic databases, catalogues of manuscript and early printed books, dialectological database, corpus databases). For natural language processing tasks, this material is the main source for understanding how the annotation of source data is organised and where aggregated characteristics are extracted from.
blocks.zh: 机器基金的结构和功能能力最完整的描述见Sirazitdinov (2025). 作者介绍了基金10个大部分的组织情况(一般词表、词典、语法、实验语言数据库、手稿目录和早期印刷书籍、辩证法数据库、委托书数据库)。 对于自然语言处理任务,这种材料是了解源数据注释如何组织以及从何处提取汇总特征的主要来源.

blocks.en: A retrospective analysis of scientific and practical activity in the field of applied linguistics at IIL UFRC RAS over more than 30 years is presented in Sirazitdinov (2024) . Over this period, an infrastructure was created for the functioning of the national language in computer technologies, theoretical foundations for an automatic morphological analyser, and phonetic, lexical and full-text linguistic databases, which made it possible to develop the information systems “Machine Fund of the Bashkir Language” and “Terminological Data Bank”.
blocks.zh: Sirazitdinov(2024年)对30多年来在IIL UFRC RAS应用语言学领域的科学和实践活动作了回顾分析。 在此期间,为国家语言在计算机技术、自动形态分析仪的理论基础以及语音、词汇和全文语言数据库方面的功能建立了基础设施,从而得以开发信息系统“Bashkir语言的Machine Fund”和“术语数据库”。

blocks.en: 2.2 Corpus Linguistics of the Bashkir Language
blocks.zh: 2.2 巴什基尔语言学

blocks.en: Practical aspects of creating corpora of the Bashkir language are considered in a number of works. In Ishmukhametova (2014) , the experience of creating a subcorpus of literary texts of the Machine Fund is described: issues of data cleaning, tokenisation and formats for encoding metatextual annotation (genre, author, year) are considered. These aspects are fundamentally important for selecting and filtering quality data during pretraining of transformer models.
blocks.zh: 一些作品中考虑了创建巴什基尔语团的实际方面. 在Ishmukhametova(2014年)中,描述了创建机器基金文学文本子公司的经验:数据清理、标识和元文字注释编码格式的问题(流派、作者、年份)。 这些方面对于在变压器模型的前期训练中选择和过滤质量数据至关重要.

blocks.en: In Buskunbaeva et al. (2018) , using the material of the folklore corpus, types of one-member sentences in the proverbial fund of the Bashkir language are described: the structural classification of proverbial constructions and the principles of their annotation in the corpus are considered. This material is important for developing syntactic analysers and for understanding how the annotation of folklore texts in Bashkir corpora is organised.
blocks.zh: 在Buskunbaeva等人(2018年)中,使用民俗教义的材料,描述了巴什基尔语谚语基金中单人句的类型:对谚语构造的结构分类及其在教义中的注解原理被考虑. 这些材料对于开发综合分析器和了解如何组织Bashkir Corpora民间文学作品的注释十分重要。

blocks.en: The dialectological aspect of corpus linguistics is presented in Sirazitdinov et al. (2016) , which describes an applied component of the Machine Fund — an integrated Dialectological Database consisting of a lexical subfund, a textological corpus and an atlas. For natural language processing tasks, the article is valuable for its description of the principles of annotation, tagging and computer recognition of regional variations of the Bashkir folklore and living continuum.
blocks.zh: Sirazitdinov等人(2016年)介绍了实体语言学的辩证法方面,介绍了机器基金的一个应用部分——一个综合的糖尿病数据库,其中包括一个词汇子基金、一个文本学本和一个地图集。 对于自然语言处理任务,文章对于描述对巴什基尔民俗和生活连续体的区域差异进行注释,标记和计算机识别的原则很有价值.

blocks.en: Issues of code-switching using the material of the journalistic corpus are considered in Buskunbaeva (2022) . Structural types of switches and borrowings are analysed, which is necessary for correct tokenisation, dataset cleaning and training transformer models to process the Russian–Bashkir bilingual context. This problem is particularly relevant because real Runet texts often contain a mixture of Russian and Bashkir.
blocks.zh: 在Buskunbaeva(2022年)中,考虑了使用新闻资料进行密码转换的问题。 分析开关和借款的结构类型,这是正确证明、数据集清理和培训变压器模型处理俄罗斯-巴什基尔双语背景所必需的。 这个问题尤其相关,因为真正的Runet文本往往含有俄语和巴什基尔语的混合物.

blocks.en: The development of an audio corpus of the eastern dialect of the Bashkir language is the subject of Buskunbaeva and Sirazitdinov (2020) . The methodology of creating an audio corpus, the principles of phonetic and acoustic annotation, the digitisation of live recordings and the alignment of audio segments with text transcripts are described. This material is important for developers of voice assistants, speech recognition systems and speech synthesis models.
blocks.zh: 发展巴什基尔语东部方言的音体是布斯昆巴耶瓦语和西拉齐季诺夫语(2020年)的主题. 报告介绍了创建音频体的方法、语音和声学注释原则、现场录音数字化以及音频部分与文字记录的一致。 此材料对于语音助理,语音识别系统和语音合成模型的开发者很重要.

blocks.en: Parameters of oral speech segmentation using the material of a media audio corpus are studied in Khamitova and Sirazitdinov (2024) : using the ELAN program, syntagms and phrase volume are analysed. In the field of speech-to-text conversion, this publication provides mathematical and linguistic parameters for segmenting the audio stream and configuring acoustic models for Bashkir speech recognition.
blocks.zh: Khamitova和Sirazitdinov(2024年)研究了使用媒体音频材料进行口头语音分区的参数: 使用ELAN程序,合成和词组音量进行分析. 在语音对文本转换领域,该出版物提供了数学和语言参数,用于分解音频流和配置巴什基尔语音识别的声学模型.

blocks.en: Finally, the Bashqort Raw Corpus dataset Khudiakova (2025) is a collection of Bashkir texts intended for continual training of large language models. The resource is published on the Hugging Face platform and is one of the few open corpora of the Bashkir language.
blocks.zh: 最后,Bashqort Raw Corpus数据集Khudiakova(2025年)是一组Bashkir文本,旨在持续培训大型语言模型。 该资源发布在Hugging Face平台上,是巴什基尔语中为数不多的开放公司之一.

blocks.en: 2.3 Lexicography, Orthography and Formal Grammar
blocks.zh: 2.3 书法、正文法和正式文法

blocks.en: The transition of classical lexicography into the digital environment is considered in Yagafarova (2015) : the structure, strengths and weaknesses of existing electronic and online Bashkir dictionaries are analysed. In solving natural language processing tasks, these materials are used to develop automatic parsers, electronic glossaries and machine translation systems.
blocks.zh: 古典词典学向数字环境的过渡在雅加法罗娃(2015年)中考虑: 分析现有的电子和在线Bashkir词典的结构、优缺点。 在解决自然语言处理任务时,这些材料被用于开发自动剖析器,电子拼音和机器翻译系统.

blocks.en: A fundamental classification of the principles of nomination and thematic groups of Bashkir vocabulary is presented in the doctoral dissertation Yagafarova (2019) . In IT developments, this structure is used to design Bashkir WordNet-like networks, build semantic ontologies, knowledge graphs and named entity extraction systems.
blocks.zh: 雅加法罗娃博士论文(2019年)对巴什基尔词汇的提名原则和专题小组进行了基本分类. 在IT开发中,这种结构被用于设计类似Bashkir WordNet的网络,构建语义本体学,知识图和命名的实体提取系统.

blocks.en: The principles of creating the information and reference portal on Bashkir orthography Belemle.ru are described in Yagafarova (2025) . For developers, the material is valuable for its description of standardised rules underlying spell-checking algorithms, automatic correction of typos and normalisation of Bashkir text before it is fed into neural network models.
blocks.zh: 建立巴什基尔正统贝伦勒信息和参考门户的原则. Ru在雅加法罗娃(2025)中描述. 对于开发者来说,该材料对于在输入神经网络模型之前描述拼写检查算法所基于的标准化规则,自动校正字典和巴什基尔文本的正常化很有价值.

blocks.en: The formalisation of Bashkir syntax from the standpoint of computer modelling is presented in Sirazitdinov (2021) : the author identifies strict models and schemes of verbal government using the material of generalised-personal proverbs. In natural language processing tasks, the formalisation of grammar makes it possible to specify rules for accurate semantic-syntactic parsing of text constructions.
blocks.zh: 从计算机建模的角度看,巴什基尔语法的正式化在Sirazitdinov(2021年)中介绍: 提交人利用通俗的个人谚语材料,确定了严格的口头管理模式和计划。 在自然语言处理任务中,语法的正规化使得可以为准确的语义-合成解析文本构造规定规则.

blocks.en: 2.4 Applied Platforms and Services
blocks.zh: 2.4 应用平台和服务

blocks.en: The software architecture of the Bashkortsoft ecosystem is considered in Gataullin and Mukhametov (2022) : modules for intelligent text analysis, an API for integrating Bashkir dictionaries into third-party IT solutions, algorithms for automatic spell-checking and normalisation of noisy user input are described. This material is important as an example of implementing applied text preprocessing pipelines before feeding data into neural networks.
blocks.zh: Bashkortsoft生态系统的软件架构在Gataullin和Mukhametov(2022年)中被考虑: 介绍了智能文本分析模块、将Bashkir字典纳入第三方IT解决方案的API、自动拼写检查算法和噪音用户输入的正常化。 这些材料作为在将数据输入神经网络之前实施应用文本预处理管道的一个例子是重要的.

blocks.en: The process of transferring scientific databases of the Machine Fund into commercial and publicly accessible web interfaces of the Bashkortsoft project is described in Sirazitdinov and Buskunbaeva (2021) . Technical problems of matching encodings, parsing large volumes of dictionary entries and optimising search queries for online translators operating in real time are considered.
blocks.zh: Sirazitdinov和Buskunbaeva(2021年)介绍了将机器基金的科学数据库转移到Bashkortsoft项目的商业和可公开访问的网页界面的过程。 考虑了编码匹配,解析大量字典条目和优化在线翻译实时运行的搜索查询的技术问题.

blocks.en: The concept of collecting open legally clean datasets for training large language models is presented in Gataullin (2024) : problems of copyright in texts are analysed, and the integration of Bashkir translation on modern IT platforms is described. The architecture of the Bashkorttele repository, including audiobooks, annotated Bashkir epics and works by classical authors, is described in Yusupova and Gataullin (2026) . The data alignment format (each audio fragment is strictly aligned with text in Bashkir and Russian) makes this work a methodological guide for training speech-to-text systems.
blocks.zh: Gataullin(2024年)介绍了为培训大型语言模型而收集开放的法律清洁数据集的概念: 对文本中的版权问题进行了分析,并介绍了Bashkir翻译在现代信息技术平台上的整合情况。 巴什科尔特勒寄存器的建筑,包括音书,注解的巴什基尔史诗和古典作者的作品,在尤苏波娃和加陶林(2026)中都有描述. 数据对齐格式(每个音频片段都严格与巴什基尔语和俄语的文本对齐)使得这项工作成为培训语音对文本系统的方法指南.

blocks.en: Scaling of the Bashkorttele data repository is described in Kilsenbaev (2026) : the structure of a trilingual parallel spoken corpus of 10,000 phrases is disclosed, as well as the integration of an archive of live Bashkir speech with a volume of 53.3 hours of clean audio based on radio programmes of the State Television and Radio Broadcasting Company “Bashkortostan”.
blocks.zh: Kilsenbaev(2026年)描述了Bashkorttele数据储存库的扩大: 根据国家电视台和广播广播公司“Bashkortostan”的广播节目,将巴什基尔现场讲话的档案与53.3小时的清洁音频结合起来。

blocks.en: 2.5 Morphology of Agglutinative Languages
blocks.zh: 2.5 阳性语言的形态学

blocks.en: A two-level morphological description of the Bashkir language is presented in Eyupoglu (2019) : the description is based on a lexicon of root words, implemented using XML and connected to the Nuve framework. The phonetic rules of the Bashkir language are encoded using 41 two-level rules. This work is one of the few attempts at a formal description of Bashkir morphology in terms of two-level morphology.
blocks.zh: 在Eyupoglu(2019年)中展示了巴什基尔语的两级形态描述: 该描述基于根词的词典,使用 XML 执行并与 Nuve 框架连接. 巴什基尔语的语音规则使用41个两级规则编码. 这部作品是对巴什基尔形态学在两级形态学上的正式描述的少数尝试之一.

blocks.en: A network model of agglutinative morphology based on graph theory is proposed in Grechachin (2018) . The model is implemented for modern Bashkir and for Old Turkic; on its basis, a morphological parser for the Old Turkic language was created.
blocks.zh: Grechachin(2018年)提出了基于图理的卵状形态学网络模型. 该模式为现代巴什基尔语和旧突厥语实施;在此基础上,为旧突厥语创建了形态剖析器.

blocks.en: A neuro-symbolic approach to the morphology of Bashkir nouns is developed in Isangulov et al. (2025) ; Isangulov et al. (2026) . In Isangulov et al. (2025) , a hybrid method is presented that combines a large language model and a finite-state automaton to ensure morphological correctness during text generation in agglutinative languages: the system automatically extracts rules from corpus data, generates context-dependent regex rules and LEXC morphotactics; the integration of the finite-state automaton into the language-model loop improved machine translation quality from BLEU 16.14 / ChrF 45.13 to BLEU 25.71 / ChrF 50.87 without retraining the translator. In Isangulov et al. (2026) , the previous version of the pipeline is extended: 69.60 % coverage was achieved and 174 of 250 forms were recognised on the same benchmark.
blocks.zh: 伊桑古洛夫等人(2025年);伊桑古洛夫等人(2026年)对巴什基尔名词的形态学形成了一种神经-同义方法. 在Isangulov等人(2025年)中,提出了一种混合方法,结合了一种大语言模型和一种有限状态的自体,以确保文本生成时在杂交语言中的形态正确性:系统自动从实体数据中提取规则,生成上下文依赖的regex规则和LEXC的形态学;将有限状态的自体结合到语言模型循环中,从BLEU 16.14 / ChrF 45.13到BLEU 25.71 / ChrF 50.87的机器翻译质量得到提高,而不对翻译者进行再培训. 在Isangulov等人案(2026年)中,先前的输油管版本被延长:覆盖率达到69.60%,250份表格中有174份在同一基准上得到承认。

blocks.en: 2.6 Turkic Languages: Corpora and Machine Translation
blocks.zh: 2.6 突厥语:Corpora和机器翻译

blocks.en: The principles of building multilingual Turkic corpora are considered in Saykhunov and Suleymanov (2019) : the architecture of cross-lingual models for closely related languages is studied, and transfer learning algorithms are proposed to improve the quality of machine translation and text classification in the low-resource Bashkir language.
blocks.zh: 在Saykhunov和Suleymanov(2019年), 研究了密切相关语言的跨语言模型结构,并提出了转移学习算法,以提高低资源巴什基尔语言的机器翻译和文本分类的质量.

blocks.en: A multilingual neural machine translation system for seven Turkic–Russian language pairs is presented in Khusainov and Suleymanov (2021) : parallel corpora with a total volume of about 7.9 million sentence pairs were created, and for the first time for Turkic languages, transfer learning experiments were conducted on a combined Russian–Turkic parallel corpus.
blocks.zh: Khusainov和Suleymanov(2021年)为7个突厥语-俄语对齐提供了多语言的神经机翻译系统: 创建了共约790万句子的平行子公司,首次对突厥语进行了合并的俄语-突厥语平行体的转移学习实验。

blocks.en: A large-scale study of machine translation in the Turkic language family is presented in Mirzakhalov et al. (2021) : a parallel corpus covering 22 Turkic languages was created, bilingual baseline models for 26 language pairs were proposed, as well as new test sets in three different translation domains.
blocks.zh: Mirzakhalov等人(2021年)介绍了对突厥语系机器翻译的大规模研究: 创建了涵盖22种突厥语的并行体,提出了26种语言对的双语基线模型,以及三个不同翻译领域的新测试套。

blocks.en: The toolkit of the “Turkic Morpheme” portal for data augmentation in low-resource machine translation is described in Gatiatullin et al. (2024) : an augmentation method based on morphological translation showed an increase in machine translation quality by the BLEU metric, especially effectively for closely related languages with similar grammar and morphology.
blocks.zh: Gatiatullin等人(2024年)介绍了“Turkic Morpheme”门户网站在低资源机器翻译中的数据增强工具包:基于形态翻译的增强方法显示,通过BLEU度量,机器翻译质量有所提高,特别是对于语法和形态学相似的密切相关语言而言。

blocks.en: Methods for creating machine translation systems for low-resource languages are considered in Suleymanov et al. (2026) : an approach combining data augmentation and knowledge transfer is proposed; BERT is chosen as the architecture, used both as an encoder and as a decoder. Parallel corpora with a total volume of about 30 million sentence pairs were collected.
blocks.zh: Suleymanov等人(2026年)考虑了为低资源语言创建机器翻译系统的方法:提出了将数据增强和知识转让相结合的方法;BERT被选为架构,既用作编码器,也用作解码器. 共收集了约3000万对句子的平行蝎子.

blocks.en: The Russian–Bashkir parallel corpus BorisTM (2025) contains 9.7 million sentence pairs filtered by semantic similarity. The corpus combines real translations and synthetic data obtained by back-translation.
blocks.zh: 俄-巴什基尔并行体BorisTM(2025)包含970万句对句被语义相似性过滤. 本体结合了真实翻译和通过反翻译获得的合成数据.

blocks.en: The application of parameter-efficient fine-tuning to the task of Russian–Bashkir machine translation is presented in Karpov (2026) : fine-tuning of nllb-200-distilled-600M with LoRA on synthetic data achieved chrF++ 46.94 for Bashkir. In Maxim (2026) , adaptation of the Tencent HY-MT1.5-7B model with LoRA is described for correcting output from Arabic script to Cyrillic in Russian–Kazakh and Russian–Bashkir pairs. In Tyurin (2026) , a comparative study of NLLB-200, M2M-100 and MarianMT architectures was conducted; the best system — a fine-tuned NLLB-200-1.3B with exact-match extraction — reached chrF++ 52.67.
blocks.zh: 对俄语-Bashkir机器翻译任务的参数效率微调应用见Karpov(2026): 在Bashkir实现chrF++ 46.94的合成数据上,将nllb-200-distilled-600M与LORA进行微调. 在Maxim (2026)中,用LORA对Tencent HY-MT1.5-7B模型的改造被描述为将阿拉伯语脚本的输出修正为俄语的西里尔字母-Kazakh和俄语-Bashkir的对子. 在Tyurin (2026)中,对NLLB-200,M2M-100和MarianMT架构进行了比较研究;最好的系统——一个精细的NLLB-200-1.3B,精确的匹配提取——达到了chrF++ 52.67.

blocks.en: 2.7 Speech Processing for Turkic Languages
blocks.zh: 2.7 突厥语的语音处理

blocks.en: The Whisper speech recognition model Radford et al. (2022) was adapted to Bashkir by reducing the vocabulary to 16,384 tokens. The Bashkort TTS dataset [ 8 ] is the largest open dataset for speech synthesis in Bashkir: 62,852 audio files, eight speakers and three speech styles.
blocks.zh: Whisper语音识别模型Radford et al. (2022)通过将词汇减少至16,384个令牌来适应巴什基尔. Bashkort TTS数据集[8]是巴什基尔最大的语音合成开放数据集:62,852个音频文件,8个扬声器和3个语音风格.

blocks.en: Multilingual speech synthesis for Turkic languages using transliteration is presented in Yeshpanov et al. (2023) : a system based on Tacotron 2 was trained only on Kazakh data, and to generate speech in other Turkic languages, letters of the alphabets are mapped to International Phonetic Alphabet symbols, which are then converted into Kazakh letters.
blocks.zh: Yeshpanov等人(2023年)介绍了使用转写法的突厥语多种语言语音合成: 一个基于Tacotron 2的系统只接受了哈萨克语数据的培训,为了生成其他突厥语的语音,字母表的字母被映射到国际字母字母符号上,然后转换成哈萨克字母.

blocks.en: Transfer learning from Kazakh for speech recognition of nine Turkic languages is studied in Orel et al. (2023) : most models built using transfer learning outperformed monolingual baselines; the most significant improvement was achieved for Yakut. Multilingual end-to-end speech recognition for five agglutinative Turkic languages with a common Cyrillic script is presented in Bekarystankyzy et al. (2024) : multilingual training improved recognition scores for all languages except Bashkir. In Bekarystankyzy et al. (2025) , an integrated end-to-end multilingual speech recognition architecture is proposed, using Connectionist Temporal Classification and an attention mechanism with a language model.
blocks.zh: Orel et al. (2023年)研究了哈萨克语的转移学习,以表彰9种突厥语: 使用转移学习构建的大多数模型都超过了单一语言基线;对Yakut来说,取得了最显著的改进。 Bekarystankyzy等人在Bekarystankyzy对常用西里尔字母的5种格氏突厥语进行多语言端对端语音识别. (2024年):除巴什基尔语外,所有语言的多语种培训提高识别分数. 在Bekarystankyzy等人(2025年)中,提出了综合端到端的多语种语音识别架构,采用了Connectist Temperoral分类法和带有语言模型的注意机制.

blocks.en: 2.8 Sentiment Analysis and Text Classification
blocks.zh: 2.8 感知分析和文字分类

blocks.en: A software solution for building classifiers for natural language text analysis is presented in Smetanina et al. (2020) : the task of sentiment analysis of Bashkir news texts is formulated, and a hybrid approach including dictionary-based methods and machine-learning methods is proposed. In Suleimanov et al. (2020) , a formal description of the term “opinion”, the sentiment analysis task, approaches to its solution and ready-made software implementations are presented; the developed solution based on the support vector machine with stochastic gradient descent demonstrated the highest scores in terms of precision, recall and F-measure.
blocks.zh: 用于自然语言文本分析的构建分类器软件解决方案在Smetanina等人(2020年)中提出:对巴什基尔新闻文本的情绪分析任务已经制定,并提出了包括基于词典的方法和机器学习方法在内的混合方法. 在Suleimanov等人(2020年)中,对“意见”一词的正式描述、情绪分析任务、其解决办法和现成软件的应用;基于支持向量机的开发的、具有扭曲梯度下降的解决方案在精确、召回和F度量方面显示得分最高。

blocks.en: 2.9 Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 2.9 参数有效微调

blocks.en: The methods of parameter-efficient fine-tuning arose as a response to the high cost of full fine-tuning of large language models. LoRA Hu et al. (2022) freezes pretrained weights and adds trainable low-rank matrices, which reduces the number of trainable parameters by several orders of magnitude. QLoRA Dettmers et al. (2023) extends this approach with 4-bit quantisation to the NF4 format, which makes it possible to fine-tune models with billions of parameters on a single GPU. DoRA Liu et al. (2024) decomposes pretrained weights into magnitude and direction, applying LoRA only to the direction update; this decomposition increases the learning capacity and stability of the method. QDoRA combines DoRA weight decomposition with 4-bit quantisation, which makes the method applicable under limited GPU memory.
blocks.zh: 参数效率微调的方法是作为对大语言模型完全微调的高成本的响应. LoRA Hu等人 (英语). (2022年)冻结了预先训练的重量,并增加了可训练的低阶矩阵,这使得可训练参数的数量减少了数个数量级. QLORA Dettmers等人(2023年)将这种方法以4位的量化方式延伸至NF4格式,这使得在单一的GPU上可以微调具有数十亿参数的模型. 多拉·刘等. (2024年)将预应力的权重分解为量和方向,只对方向更新应用LORA;这种分解提高了方法的学习能力和稳定性. QDORA将DoRA的重量分解与4位量化相结合,这使得方法在有限的GPU内存下适用.

blocks.en: In this work, QLoRA is used among the methods listed above: it is implemented in all PEFT experiments and forms the basis of the comparative analysis. Unquantised LoRA does not fit into 24 GB of NVIDIA L4 memory for 7–8B models and was not run in the configuration reported here; DoRA and QDoRA are planned as an extension and require further validation of compatibility with 4-bit quantisation in the Colab environment.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,QLORA在上述方法中被使用:它在所有PEFT实验中都得到实施,并构成比较分析的基础. 未经定量的LORA不符合7–8B型号的24GB的NVIDIA L4内存,没有在此处报告的配置中运行;DORA和QDoRA作为扩展计划,需要进一步验证与Colab环境中的4位量化的兼容性.

blocks.en: 2.10 Application of PEFT to Turkic Languages
blocks.zh: 2.10 PEFT在突厥语中的应用

blocks.en: A comparative study of LoRA and QLoRA methods for the Bashkir language is presented in (2026) : experiments were conducted on a corpus of 71 thousand documents (46.9 million tokens) using DistilGPT2, GPT-2, Phi-2, Qwen2.5-7B, DeepSeek-7B and Mistral-7B. The best perplexity was obtained for GPT-2 medium with full fine-tuning (3.34), while QLoRA for Mistral-7B (3.79) and Phi-2 (3.81) achieved comparable quality with 40 times fewer trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 关于巴什基尔语LORA和QLORA方法的比较研究载于(2026年): 利用DistilGPT2、GPT-2、Phi-2、Quen2.5-7B、DeepSeek-7B和Mistral-7B对71,000份文件(4,690万令牌)进行了实验。 为GPT-2介质获得了最佳的通透性,并进行了全微调(3.34),而为Mistral-7B(3.79)和Phi-2(3.81)提供的QLORA则实现了相当的质量,减少了40倍的可训练参数.

blocks.en: Application of LoRA and QLoRA to the Tatar language is studied in Burnashev et al. (2026) : QLoRA adaptation of Mistral-7B reached a perplexity of 3.98 on the test set, comparable to fully fine-tuned gpt2-medium (2.91). Mistral-7B outperformed Qwen2.5-7B (perplexity 5.44) and DeepSeek-7B (perplexity 5.32) in adaptation to Tatar. Increasing the LoRA rank from 8 to 16 consistently improved performance across all architectures.
blocks.zh: 伯纳舍夫等人(2026年)研究了洛拉语和QLORA语在鞑靼语中的应用: QLORA对Mistral-7B的适应在测试集上达到了3.98的复杂度,与完全微调的gpt2-中度(2.91)相当. Mistral-7B在适应鞑靼时的表现超过了Quen2.5-7B(复杂度5.44)和DeepSeek-7B(复杂度5.32). 将LORA的级别从8名提高至16名,持续改善所有建筑的绩效。

blocks.en: Combining classical and transformer approaches for text classification and topic modelling of the Tatar language is presented in Arabov et al. (2026c) : on a news corpus of 153,162 documents, classical approaches (TF-IDF+LR, FastText+LR) and transformer architectures (mBERT, XLM-R, DistilBERT) were systematically compared on three tasks — binary, multiclass (9 categories) and multilabel (13 categories).
blocks.zh: Arabov等人(2026年c)介绍了鞑靼语文本分类和专题建模的经典和变压器方法: 关于153,162份文件的新闻汇编、经典方法(TF-IDF+LR、FastText+LR)和变压器架构(mBERT、XLM-R、DistilBERT)在三项任务——二进制、多类(9类)和多标签(13类)——上进行了系统比较。

blocks.en: Modelling subword embeddings for low-resource languages in the context of Industry 4.0 is presented in Arabov et al. (2026b) : using Tatar as an example, a comparative analysis of Word2Vec and FastText architectures was carried out; subword approaches using character n-grams significantly improved robustness to rare and unseen word forms.
blocks.zh: Arabov等人(2026年b)在Industrial 4.0中介绍了对低资源语言的建模子词嵌入:以鞑靼语为例,对Word2Vec和FastText架构进行了比较分析;使用字符ng的子词方法大大改进了强性,使之达到稀有和隐形的单词形式.

blocks.en: A comprehensive study of Tatar text classification methods — from corpus creation and Tatar2Vec vector models to benchmark construction — is presented in Arabov et al. (2026a) : the TatCorp 222M corpus, TatarTokenizers tokenisers, Tatar2Vec models and an annotated dataset of 13,160 texts in ten topic categories were created. It was established that the use of subword BPE tokenisation in the task of topic categorisation of an agglutinative language systematically reduces classification quality.
blocks.zh: Arabov等人(2026年a)介绍了对鞑靼文字分类方法的全面研究——从造物和鞑靼2Vec矢量模型到基准构造——:TatCorp 222Mecus、鞑靼2Vec模型和10个专题类别13 160个文字的附加说明数据集。 经确定,在对一种附加语言进行分类的专题中,使用BPE子词表示符号,系统地降低了分类质量。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overall Research Design
blocks.zh: 3.1 总体研究设计

blocks.en: The experimental study is organised as a six-stage pipeline presented in Figure 1 . In the first stage, the Bashkir Web Corpus is constructed. In the second, preprocessing and stratified splitting of the data in an 80/10/10 proportion are performed. In the third, three datasets for classification tasks are created from the news sources of the corpus: binary, multiclass and multilabel. In the fourth, eight large language model architectures are selected in the range from 82M to 8B parameters. In the fifth, three groups of adaptation strategies are applied: parameter-efficient fine-tuning, in-context learning and full fine-tuning. In the sixth, a multi-component evaluation is conducted using metrics of language modelling, classification, computational efficiency and generation quality. This organisation makes it possible to trace the path from the source data to the final conclusions sequentially and ensures the reproducibility of each stage.
blocks.zh: 实验研究是按图1所示的六阶段管道安排的。 第一阶段建造了Bashkir Web Corpus. 第二,按80/10/10的比例对数据进行预处理和分级划分。 第三,分类任务的三套数据集由本体的新闻来源创建:二进制,多类和多标签. 在第四部中,从82M到8B参数范围选择了8个大语言模型架构. 第五,适用三组适应战略:参数高效精细化,内涵学习和全精细化. 在第六组中,采用语言建模、分类、计算效率和生成质量等衡量标准进行多组成部分评价。 这个组织使得能够按顺序追踪从源数据到最后结论的路径,并确保每个阶段的可复制性。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overall experimental pipeline
blocks.zh: 图1:整个试验管道

blocks.en: 3.2 The Bashkir Web Corpus
blocks.zh: 3.2 巴什基尔网络公司

blocks.en: The resource basis of the study is the Bashkir Web Corpus BashkirNLPWorld (2026) — a corpus of the Bashkir language with a volume of 71,567 documents and about 46.9 million tokens, collected from 16 open internet resources including news portals, literary journals, social media, books and Wikipedia. The distribution of sources is uneven: the Bashkir Wikipedia ( bawiki_cyrillic ) provides 42,262 documents, which constitutes 59.0% of the corpus, the portal azatliqorg provides 7,541 documents (10.5%), while the remaining 14 sources are represented by volumes from 151 to 2,139 documents and together cover 30.5%. A document is described by five fields: title (headline, available for 99.4% of documents), content (main text), category (topic category, 97.8%), source (source identifier) and text (the combined string title + content , prepared for input to the model). The corpus is available in two configurations: full (71,567 documents) and sample (1,000 documents for debugging). The licensing model follows the practice of large web corpora such as HPLT and OSCAR: the source texts retain the rights of authors and publishers, while the structured compilation, metadata and original annotations are distributed under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence with an active notice-and-takedown procedure and a commitment to respond within 14 working days. The main limitation of the corpus is the imbalance of sources: 59% of documents belong to the encyclopaedic genre, which creates a stylistic shift towards the formal register. Additional limitations are the absence of publication dates, residual web noise and domain unevenness, which must be taken into account when training models and interpreting results.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的资源基础是Bashkir Web Corpus BashkirNLPWorld(2026年)——一个Bashkir语言体,拥有71567份文件和约4,690万个信物,从16个开放的互联网资源中收集,包括新闻门户,文学期刊,社交媒体,书籍和维基百科. 来源分布不均:巴什基尔维基百科(bawiki_cyrillic)提供42,262份文件,占诉讼文书的59.0%,Azatliqorg门户网站提供7,541份文件(10.5%),其余14个来源则以151至2,139份文件的卷数为代表,总共占30.5%。 文件由五个字段描述:标题(标题,99.4%的文件可用),内容(主要文本),类别(专题类别,97.8%),来源(来源标识符)和文本(合并字符串标题+内容,为输入模型准备). 书目有两种配置:完整(71 567份文件)和样本(1 000份文件用于调试)。 许可模式遵循HPLT和OSCAR等大型网络公司的做法:源文本保留作者和出版商的权利,而结构化的编译,元数据和原始说明则在CC BY-SA 4.0许可下发布,并有积极的通知和收购程序,承诺在14个工作日内回复. 书目的主要限制是来源的不平衡:59%的文件属于百科全书流派,这造成了向正式注册的风格转变. 其他限制包括没有出版日期、网络噪音和域位不均,在培训模式和解释结果时必须考虑到这一点。

blocks.en: 3.3 Datasets for Downstream Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.3 下游任务数据集

blocks.en: Three datasets covering text classification tasks of varying complexity were formed on the basis of the news sources of the corpus. The binary classification dataset Arabov and Khaybullina (2026a) includes 16,994 documents with two balanced classes: news (label 1) and analysis (label 0), with 8,497 examples in each. The labelling was performed automatically on the basis of normalised source categories: all news categories were assigned to label 1, the rest to label 0. Balancing was achieved by undersampling, during which 7,434 analytical articles were removed. The data were collected from 14 Bashkir online sources, with azatliqorg providing 28% of the documents. The main limitations are related to the possible loss of diversity in the analysis class due to undersampling and to the incomplete correspondence of categories to the intuitive distinction between news and analysis.
blocks.zh: 根据本文书的新闻来源,形成了三个数据集,涵盖复杂程度不同的文本分类任务。 二进制分类数据集Arabov和Khaybullina (2026a)包括16,994份文件,有两个平衡的分类:新闻(标签1)和分析(标签0),每个有8,497例. 标签是根据正常的源类别自动执行的:所有新闻类别都被分配到标签1,其余则被分配到标签中 零点 平衡是通过采样不足实现的,在此期间删除了7,434篇分析文章. 从14个Bashkir在线来源收集数据,其中azatliqorg提供了28%的文件。 主要局限与分析课可能因采样不足而失去多样性有关,与新闻和分析之间直觉区分的类别对应不全有关.

blocks.en: The multiclass classification dataset Arabov and Khaybullina (2026b) includes 17,897 documents labelled with 19 topic categories; each document belongs to exactly one category. The threshold for category selection was set at 150 examples. The class distribution is strongly imbalanced: the category “News” (“Яылытар”) contains 8,497 documents, which constitutes 47.5% of the corpus, whereas the categories “Bashkortostan” and “History” are represented by only 156 and 159 documents (0.9% each). Intermediate categories include “Society” (15.8%), “Education” (4.2%), “Culture” (3.0%), “Religion” (2.1%) and “Sport” (1.0%).
blocks.zh: 多类分类数据集Arabov和Khaybullina (2026b)包含17,897个文件,标有19个主题类别;每个文件完全属于一个类别. 类别选择的门槛定为150个实例。 类别分布严重不平衡: " 新闻 " ( " QQ " )类别包含8,497份文件,占诉讼事由的47.5%,而 " 巴什科尔托斯坦 " 和 " 历史 " 类别仅代表156和159份文件(各占0.9%)。 中级类别包括“社会”(15.8%)、“教育”(4.2%)、“文化”(3.0%)、“宗教”(2.1%)和“体育”(1.0%)。

blocks.en: The multilabel classification dataset Arabov and Khaybullina (2026c) includes 22,318 documents with 14 topic labels, where each document may belong to several categories simultaneously, and the average number of labels per document is 3.6. The labelling was performed automatically on the basis of keywords: for each label, a dictionary of Bashkir keywords was formed, which were scanned in the headline and text of the article, and in the absence of matches the original category of the document was applied. The most frequent label is “Society” with 12,251 occurrences (55.1%), the least frequent is “Fiction” with 1,880 occurrences (8.4%). The most common label pairs are “Religion + Society” (22.6%), “World + Society” (20.8%), “Bashkortostan + Society” (19.2%). The limitations of this dataset are related to the possible bias of keyword-based labelling and to the sparsity of rare labels.
blocks.zh: 多标签分类数据集Arabov和Khaybullina(2026c)包含22,318个文件,其中14个主题标签,每个文件可能同时属于多个类别,每个文件的平均标签数量为3.6. 标签是根据关键词自动执行的:对于每个标签,都形成了巴什基尔关键词的词典,在文章头条和文字中扫描,在没有匹配的情况下,应用了文档的原始类别. 最常见的标签是“协会”,有12 251次(55.1%),最不常见的是1 880次(8.4%)。 最常见的标签对是“宗教+社会”(22.6%)、“世界+社会”(20.8%)、“巴什科尔托斯坦+社会”(19.2%)。 本数据集的局限性与基于关键词的标签可能存在偏差,以及稀有标签的伸缩性有关.

blocks.en: For each of the three datasets, stratified splits in an 80/10/10 proportion are formed, preserving the proportions of sources and categories with a fixed random seed, which excludes data leakage between samples and ensures comparability of results. Preprocessing includes extraction of text from HTML markup, removal of duplicates, normalisation of categories and unification of document length; at the stage of dataset formation, length constraints from 50 to 10,000 characters were applied Arabov and Khaybullina (2026a) ; Arabov and Khaybullina (2026b) ; Arabov and Khaybullina (2026c) , and for language modelling experiments the maximum sequence length was set to 128 tokens.
blocks.zh: 对于三个数据集中的每一组,均以80/10/10的比例分层形成,保留了具有固定随机种子的源和类别的比例,排除了样本间数据泄露,并确保结果的可比性. 预处理包括从HTML标记中提取文本,去除重复,实现类别正常化和文件长度的统一;在数据集形成阶段,应用了50到10,000个字符的长度限制Arabov和Khaybullina(2026a);Arabov和Khaybullina(2026b);Arabov和Khaybullina(2026c),语言建模实验将最大序列长度设定为128个符.

blocks.en: 3.4 Models
blocks.zh: 3.4 模式

blocks.en: For the comparative analysis, eight open architectures were selected in the range from 82M to 8B parameters. All models are available for local deployment without proprietary APIs and are distributed under open licences (Apache 2.0 or MIT) permitting academic use. Computations were performed in the Google Colab Pro environment with an NVIDIA L4 GPU (24 GB), which imposes constraints on the maximum model size and GPU memory volume.
blocks.zh: 为了进行比较分析,从82M到8B参数范围选择了8个开放式架构. 所有型号都可以在当地使用,没有专有的API,并以开放许可证(APAche 2.0或麻省理工学院)发放,允许学术使用. 计算是在Google Colab Pro环境中用一个NVIDIA L4 GPU(24 GB)进行,它给最大模型大小和GPU内存量施加了限制.

blocks.en: Group of small models for full fine-tuning. DistilGPT2 (82M), GPT-2 base (124M), GPT-2 medium (355M). These architectures fit into GPU memory without quantisation and allow full fine-tuning of all parameters, which provides a baseline for comparison with parameter-efficient methods.
blocks.zh: 全面微调小模型组. DistilGPT2(82M),GPT-2碱(124M),GPT-2介质(355M). 这些架构与GPU内存兼容,不进行量化,并允许对所有参数进行全面的微调,这为与参数效率方法进行比较提供了基线.

blocks.en: Group of medium-scale generative models for PEFT and CPT. Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct (3.8B) — a compact instruction-tuned model with a 4K-token context; Mistral-7B-v0.3 (7B) — a reference architecture widely used in studies on low-resource languages (2026) ; Burnashev et al. (2026) ; YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B-instruct (8B) — a Russian-language model with a Cyrillic tokeniser, included to test the hypothesis that the language proximity of pretraining (Russian) provides priors for Bashkir. All three models are loaded in 4-bit NF4 quantisation.
blocks.zh: PEFT和CPT的中尺度基因模型组. Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct(3.8B) – 一种带有4K-token语境的紧凑指令调制模型; Mistral-7B-v0.3 (7B) – 在低资源语言研究中广泛使用的参考架构 (2026) ; Burnashev 等人 (2026) ; YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B-instruct (8B) – 一种带有西里尔语代号的俄语模型,包括测试预训(俄语)语言接近为巴什基尔提供前身的假设. 所有三种型号都以4位NF4量化法加载.

blocks.en: Group of encoder-only models for classification. mBERT (bert-base-multilingual-cased, 178M) and XLM-R (xlm-roberta-base, 278M) — standard multilingual baseline architectures trained by full fine-tuning on the same data.
blocks.zh: 分类只使用编码器模型组. mBERT(英语:bert-base-multiple-case,178M)和XLM-R(英语:xlm-roberta-base,278M)——通过对同一数据进行全面微调培训的标准多语种基线架构.

blocks.en: The computational environment imposes three constraints: the maximum model size is limited to ∼ \sim 14B parameters under 4-bit quantisation; full fine-tuning is impossible for models above 2.7B parameters; the batch size for 7B–8B models is equal to one. These constraints do not affect the correctness of comparing methods within a single architecture, since all methods are applied to the same base model under identical conditions.
blocks.zh: 计算环境施加了三个限制:最大模型大小在4位量化下限制为\\sim 14B参数;2.7B参数以上的模型无法完全微调;7B–8B模型的批量大小等于1. 这些制约因素并不影响在一个单一架构内比较方法的正确性,因为所有方法都在相同条件下适用于同一个基模型.

blocks.en: 3.5 Adaptation Strategies
blocks.zh: 3.5 适应战略

blocks.en: The work compares three groups of strategies for adapting large language models to the Bashkir language: parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), in-context learning (ICL) and full fine-tuning (Full FT). In addition, continual pretraining (CPT) is tested as a preliminary stage before PEFT adaptation.
blocks.zh: 作品比较了三组使大型语言模型适应巴什基尔语的战略:参数效率微调(PEFT),内文本学习(ICL)和全微调(Full FT). 此外,在PEFT适应之前,作为初步阶段测试持续预训。

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning. The first group includes two methods: LoRA Hu et al. (2022) and QLoRA Dettmers et al. (2023) . LoRA freezes the original parameters of the model and adds trainable low-rank matrices to the specified layers; rank r = 16 r=16 and scaling coefficient α = 2 ​ r = 32 \alpha=2r=32 are used for language modelling, dropout 0.05 and targeting of all linear layers ( all-linear : attention projections and MLP blocks). QLoRA Dettmers et al. (2023) extends LoRA with 4-bit weight quantisation to the NF4 format and is applied to all generative models from 2.7B parameters, since quantisation reduces GPU memory requirements and allows models with billions of parameters to be fine-tuned on available resources.
blocks.zh: 参数高效微调. 第一组包括两种方法:LORA Hu等人(2022年)和QLORA Dettmers等人(2023年). LORA冻结模型的原始参数,并将可训练的低阶矩阵添加到指定的层中;排名r = 16 r = 16,并缩放系数α = 2 r = 32\alpha = 2r = 32用于语言建模,退出 0.05 和瞄准所有线性层(全线性:注意力预测和MLP块). QLORA Dettmers等人(2023年)将4位重量化的LORA扩展至NF4格式,并应用于2.7B参数中的所有基因模型,因为量化降低了GPU的内存要求,并允许数十亿参数的模型根据现有资源进行微调.

blocks.en: In the paper configuration, the main analysis is conducted for QLoRA. Unquantised LoRA does not fit into 24 GB of NVIDIA L4 memory for 7–8B models (it requires ∼ \sim 28–32 GB depending on sequence length and batch size), so in the paper preset for medium-scale generative models only QLoRA was run. For small models (DistilGPT2, GPT-2 base, GPT-2 medium), full fine-tuning was performed in the paper configuration (Section 4.1 ), which for these architectures fits into memory without quantisation and serves as a baseline. LoRA results for small models are not reported in the paper configuration.
blocks.zh: 在纸张配置中,主要分析为QLORA. 无量化的LORA不符合7–8B模型的24GB的NVIDIA L4内存(根据序列长度和批量大小需要\sim 28–32 GB),所以在中尺度基因模型的纸张预设中只运行了QLORA. 对于小型模型(DistilGPT2,GPT-2基,GPT-2介质),在纸张配置中进行了全面的微调(第4.1节),对于这些结构来说,这些结构适合不量化的内存,并作为一个基线. 小模型的LORA结果没有在纸张配置中报告.

blocks.en: For classification tasks (step6), QLoRA with rank r = 8 r=8 is used; for downstream adaptation after CPT (step4), QLoRA with rank r = 16 r=16 and α = 32 \alpha=32 . The difference in ranks is due to different memory budgets: in step6 the model must simultaneously hold the classification head and the test dataset in memory throughout the run, whereas in step4 downstream adaptation is performed sequentially by model, and rank r = 16 r=16 is permissible. Both configurations use the same value max_seq_len = 128 =128 .
blocks.zh: 用于分类任务(step6),使用级别为r=8r=8的QLORA;在CPT(step4)之后的下游适应,使用级别为r=16r=16的QLORA,α=32\alpha=32. 排名差异是由于内存预算不同:在步骤6中,模型必须同时将分类头和测试数据集保存在内存中,而在步骤4中,下游适应则按模型顺序进行,等级r=16r=16是允许的. 两种配置使用相同的值max_seq_len=128=128.

blocks.en: Continual pretraining (CPT). To test the hypothesis of the benefit of additional pretraining on the Bashkir corpus, a separate series of experiments was conducted. LoRA adaptation ( r = 16 r=16 , α = 32 \alpha=32 ) is applied to the base model on the Bashkir Web Corpus (10,000 documents, 1 epoch, lr = 10 − 5 \text{lr}=10^{-5} ), after which the adapter is merged into the base weights, and QLoRA adaptation ( r = 16 r=16 , α = 32 \alpha=32 ) to the downstream task is performed on the resulting model. The series was conducted for three medium-scale generative models — Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B. Two configurations are compared: qlora_no_cpt (QLoRA without CPT) and cpt_then_qlora (CPT + QLoRA).
blocks.zh: 连续预训(CPT). 为了测试对巴什基尔人进行额外预训的好处这一假设,单独进行了一系列实验。 LoRA 适应(r = 16 r = 16,α = 32\ alpha = 32)应用在巴什基尔网络公司(10,000文档,1 epoc,lr = 10 – 5\ text{lr}=10^{-5})上的基础模型上,之后适配器被合并为基重,QLORA 适应(r = 16 r = 16,α = 32\ alpha = 32)在由此产生的模型上执行下游任务. 该系列为三种中等规模的基因模型——Phi-3-mini,Mistral-7B和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B进行. 比较两个配置:qlora_no_cpt(QLORA没有CPT)和cpt_then_qlora(CPT + QLORA).

blocks.en:
In-context learning. The second group of strategies does not
involve updating model parameters and includes two modes. In zero-shot
mode, the model receives only the instruction without examples; in
few-shot mode, 1, 4 or 8 examples in the prompt (the main analysis
includes 4 and 8 as more stable; at k = 1 k=1 high variance across models
and instruction languages is observed). Instructions are presented in
three languages: Bashkir, Russian and English; the order of examples
is varied. In the paper configuration, ICL was applied to five models:
DistilGPT2, Phi-2, Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B.
DistilGPT2 and Phi-2 do not produce an answer in the required format
“Answer: 0/1” (the parser returns None ), so their results
in Section 4.5 are 0.000 0.000 ; GPT-2 base and GPT-2 medium were
not run in the paper ICL configuration (Section 6.6 ).
The comparison of PEFT and ICL answers the research question of what
is more effective for the Bashkir language — updating parameters or
in-context learning, given the weak representation of Bashkir in the
pretraining of modern LLMs.
blocks.zh:
内结习. 第二组战略没有
涉及更新模型参数,并包括两种模式。 以零镜头

blocks.en: Full fine-tuning. The third group updates all parameters of the model on the training data. It is applied to small models (DistilGPT2, GPT-2 base, GPT-2 medium) and to encoder-only baselines (mBERT, XLM-R). Their inclusion requires further validation of compatibility with 4-bit quantisation in the Colab environment and assessment of computational efficiency under limited GPU memory; therefore these configurations are not included in the current analysis.

blocks.en: 3.6 Hyperparameters and Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.6 超参数和计量

blocks.en: Training was performed using the Transformers (v5.x) and PEFT (v0.21+) libraries. The maximum sequence length is 128 tokens for language modelling and classification, 256 tokens for CPT. The optimiser is AdamW (via paged_adamw_8bit for 4-bit models).
blocks.zh: 培训使用变形器(v5.x)和PEFT(v0.21+)图书馆进行。 最大序列长度为128个符号用于语言建模和分类,256个符号用于CPT. opimiser为AdamW(通过paged_adamw_8bit为4位模型).

blocks.en: The hyperparameters by experiment group are given in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 表1按实验组列出了超参数。

blocks.en: Table 1: Hyperparameters by experiment group
blocks.zh: 表1:按实验组分列的超参数

blocks.en: Random seeds. Two seeds (42, 123) were used for full fine-tuning, which allows the spread of metrics to be estimated. For PEFT/CPT experiments, one seed (42) was used due to computational constraints. A single seed limits the statistical power of comparisons between PEFT configurations: the standard deviation of metrics across seeds is not estimated, and conclusions about the superiority of one QLoRA configuration over another are formulated on the basis of point estimates and bootstrap confidence intervals on the test set rather than between-seed variability.
blocks.zh: 随机种子. 两颗种子(42,123)用于完全微调,从而可以估计度量衡的传播. 对于PEFT/CPT实验,由于计算限制,使用了一个种子(42). 单一种子限制了PEFT配置比较的统计力:没有估计不同种子的度量标准偏差,关于一个QLORA配置优于另一个配置的结论是根据测试集的点数估计和靴子置信间隔,而不是种子间变异性得出的.

blocks.en: Metrics. Evaluation is conducted across the following groups.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 评估由下列群体进行。

blocks.en: Language modelling. Perplexity on the test set, as well as bits-per-byte (BPB) — a metric normalised by the number of bytes and independent of vocabulary size (2026) , which allows models with different tokenisers to be compared.
blocks.zh: 语言建模. 测试集上的复杂度,以及比特-每字节(BPB)——一个由字节数和词汇大小独立(2026)的度量常态化,可以比较不同符号的模型.

blocks.en: Classification. Macro-F1 and weighted-F1 for binary and multiclass tasks. Due to the strong class imbalance in the multiclass dataset (47.5% of examples belong to one category), a majority baseline is additionally reported.
blocks.zh: 分类 宏-F1和加权-F1用于二进制和多类任务. 由于多类数据集(47.5%的示例属于一类)的类别严重失衡,另外还报告了大多数基线。

blocks.en: Computational efficiency. Number of trainable parameters (absolute and as a percentage of the total), training time and peak GPU memory consumption.
blocks.zh: 计算效率。 可训练参数的数量(绝对和占总数的百分比),训练时间和GPU内存消耗高峰.

blocks.en: Generation quality. Target-language token ratio — a metric reflecting the model’s tendency to switch to other languages; computed for full FT and QLoRA experiments.
blocks.zh: 世代质量. 目标语言符号比率——反映该模型转向其他语言的倾向的衡量标准;为完全FT和QLORA实验计算。

blocks.en: Tokeniser analysis. Fertility rate — the average number of subtokens per word on the Bashkir, English and Turkish test sets. Morphological Boundary Accuracy (MorphAcc) — the proportion of subtokens whose right boundary coincides with a morpheme boundary. OOV rate — the proportion of word forms split into individual bytes or characters. The ratio fertility ba {}_{\text{ba}} /fertility tr {}_{\text{tr}} is used as a measure of the penalty for low-resource status under fixed agglutinative morphology.

LLM-as-Judge. Three local LLM judges (pollux-judge-7b, M-Prometheus-7B, saiga_llama3_8b) are used to assess generation quality in three modes: direct scoring (rating on a 1–5 scale for grammar, coherence and language correctness), granular decomposition (morphology, lexicon, syntax) and pairwise ranking with control for presentation order. Human validation with three native Bashkir speakers ( n = 100 n=100 ) showed Krippendorff’s α = 0.694 \alpha=0.694 – 0.772 0.772 for the three criteria, which exceeds the threshold α ≥ 0.667 \alpha\geq 0.667 for acceptable agreement krippendorff2011computing . Native-speaker ratings are used as a validation signal for LLM-as-Judge and as an independent assessment of generation quality; the sample of 100 texts is unbalanced across models (9–23 per model), which limits the statistical power of pairwise comparisons.
blocks.zh: LLM -as -法官。 3名当地LLM评委(pollus-judge-7b,M-Prometheus-7B,saiga_llama3_8b)用于评估生成质量的三种模式:直接评分(在1–5级评分上评分的语法,一致性和语言正确性),颗粒分解(形态学,词典,语法)和配对排序与演示顺序的控制. 人类用三个本地的巴什基尔扬声器(n = 100 n = 100)进行验证,显示克里彭多夫的α = 0.694\alpha = 0.694 — 0.772 0.772 三条标准,超过 α → 0.667\alpha\geq 0.667 可接受协议 krippendorff 2011computing 。 母语的评级被用作LLM-as-Judge的验证信号和对生成质量的独立评估;100种文本的样本在模型之间不平衡(每个模型9-23种),限制了对等比较的统计力.

blocks.en: Statistical tests. For pairwise comparisons of accuracy on classification tasks, McNemar’s exact test is used; for paired continuous metrics (perplexity, BPB, native-speaker ratings), a paired bootstrap centred on the observed difference is used. Multiple comparisons are controlled by the Holm–Bonferroni correction with family-wise α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ; the number of comparisons in the family is indicated in the caption of each table (5–18 depending on the section). The number of bootstrap iterations is indicated in the captions of the corresponding tables. Effect size is reported as Cohen’s d d and Cliff’s δ \delta ; interpretation of δ \delta follows the thresholds negligible ( < 0.147 <0.147 ), small ( 0.147 0.147 – 0.33 0.33 ), medium ( 0.33 0.33 – 0.474 0.474 ), large ( ≥ 0.474 \geq 0.474 ).
blocks.zh: 统计考证. 为了对分类任务的准确性进行双向比较,采用了麦克内马尔的精确测试;对对对连续的计量(复杂度、BPB、母语评级),采用了以观测到的差异为中心的对对靴。 多项比较由Holm–Bonferroni的校正控制,与家庭的α = 0.05\alpha= 0.05;每个表格的标题中都注明了家庭的比较次数(5–18,依章节而定)。 相应表格的标题中注明了靴子重复次数。 影响大小报告为Cohen d 和 Cliff 的 \\ delta ; 对 \\ delta 的解释遵循可忽略的阈值( < 0147 < 0.147),小(0.147 0147–0.33 0.33),中(0.33 0.33–0.474 0.474),大(0.474\ geq 0474)。

blocks.en: 3.7 Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 3.7 可复制性

blocks.en: All research artefacts are released under open licences: the source code of the experiments, preprocessing scripts, trained adapters for all configurations presented in Section 4 , and the Bashkir Web Corpus itself. The corpus is available in two configurations — full (71,567 documents) and sample (1,000 documents for debugging). The binary, multiclass and multilabel classification datasets are published as separate repositories on Hugging Face with fixed 80/10/10 splits and the random seed indicated.
blocks.zh: 所有研究工艺品都根据开放许可证发放:实验的源代码、预处理脚本、第4节中所有配置的训练有素的适配器,以及Bashkir网络公司本身。 书目分为两种配置——完整(71 567份文件)和样本(1 000份文件用于调试)。 二进制,多类和多标签分类数据集在Hugging Face上作为单独的寄存器发布,固定的80/10/10拆分和标注的随机种子.

blocks.en: For PEFT experiments (QLoRA, CPT + QLoRA), one random seed (42) was used; for full fine-tuning, two (42, 123) were used. A single seed for PEFT limits the statistical power of comparisons between methods; this limitation is discussed in more detail in Section 3.6 , in the paragraph ‘Random Seeds’. Final confirmation of differences between QLoRA configurations requires expanding the number of seeds to three or more.
blocks.zh: 对于PEFT实验(QLORA,CPT + QLORA),使用了1个随机种子(42);用于完全微调,使用了2个(42,123). PEFT的单一种子限制了方法比较的统计力;第3.6节,即 " 兰东种子 " 段更详细地讨论了这一限制。 最后确认QLORA配置之间的差异需要将种子数量扩大到3个或更多.

blocks.en: The ranking by PPL and by BPB differs. By PPL, the lowest value is shown by GPT-2 medium ( 2.33 2.33 ), followed by GPT-2 base ( 2.49 2.49 ) and DistilGPT2 ( 2.69 2.69 ); the medium-scale QLoRA models occupy the positions Mistral-7B 2.90 2.90 , YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B 3.29 3.29 , Phi-3-mini 4.12 4.12 . By BPB, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B leads ( 0.462 0.462 ), followed by Mistral-7B ( 0.549 0.549 ) and Phi-3-mini ( 0.704 0.704 ); the GPT-2 family is at 0.784 0.784 – 0.917 0.917 . The discrepancy is explained by the difference in tokenisers (Section 4.8 ): with a fertility rate of 7.80 7.80 for GPT-2 versus 3.80 3.80 – 4.81 4.81 for Mistral-7B and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, each GPT-2 token covers fewer characters, which underestimates perplexity at comparable next-byte prediction quality. The absolute PPL values in this work are lower than in (2026) on the same corpus (GPT-2 medium: 2.33 2.33 versus 3.34 3.34 ; Mistral-7B QLoRA: 2.90 2.90 versus 3.79 3.79 ). The difference is explained by differences in the evaluation procedure: this work uses truncation of test sequences to 128 tokens and per-token NLL aggregation (Section 6.5 ), whereas (2026) used a different max_seq_len value and a different NLL aggregation scheme. The relative ordering of models by PPL and by BPB coincides between the works; BPB, which is invariant to the aggregation scheme, is used as the primary metric for cross-model comparison. Within the QLoRA group, the discrepancy between PPL and BPB is confirmed statistically: all six pairwise comparisons (PPL and BPB for three model pairs) are significant after Holm correction ( p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 , n = 2000 n=2000 ; Table 3 ).

The lowest proportion of Bashkir tokens is in GPT-2 medium ( 0.271 0.271 , that is, 72.9 % 72.9\,\% of generated tokens belong to other languages, predominantly English); QLoRA maintains a higher proportion of Bashkir regardless of the base architecture.

blocks.en: Catastrophic forgetting. Full fine-tuning of all three small models is accompanied by degradation on the languages of the original pretraining. Table 4 reports perplexity and bits-per-byte on English (WikiText-2, n = 200 n=200 ) and Russian (Wikipedia, n = 200 n=200 ) before and after full fine-tuning, averaged over two seeds (42, 123); the difference between seeds does not exceed 5 %.
blocks.zh: 灾难忘却. 所有三个小模型的完全微调伴随着在原始预训语言上的退化. 表4报告在充分微调前后的英语(WikiText-2,n = 200n = 200)和俄语(Wikipedia,n = 200n = 200)上出现偏差和比特/字节,平均分布在两个种子上(42,123);种子之间的差别不超过5%.

blocks.en: Table 4: Catastrophic forgetting: perplexity and BPB on English and Russian before and after full fine-tuning on Bashkir ( n = 200 n=200 texts per language, average over two seeds)
blocks.zh: 表4:灾难性遗忘:在对巴什基尔语进行充分微调之前和之后,英语和俄语的模糊性和BPB(n = 200n = 200文本/语言,平均有两个种子以上)

blocks.en: By perplexity on English, the degradation is 38 38 – 76 76 times; by BPB, it is 1.83 1.83 – 2.08 2.08 times ( 1.16 1.16 – 1.38 → 2.31 1.38\to 2.31 – 2.63 2.63 ). The discrepancy is explained by the mechanism described in Section 6.5 : after fine-tuning on Bashkir, the model shifts the distribution towards Bashkir BPE tokens, and the number of tokens for encoding English text changes; PPL, normalised per token, increases, whereas BPB, normalised per byte, grows moderately. BPB is used as the primary metric for retention of the original competence.
blocks.zh: 由于对英语的迷惑,降解为38 38 – 76 76倍;通过BPB,降解为1.83 1.83 – 2.08 2.08倍(1.16 1.16 – 1.38 – 2.31 1.38\to 2.31 – 2.63 2.63). 第6.5节所描述的机制解释了这一差异:在对Bashkir进行微调后,该模型将发行量转向Bashkir BPE令牌,以及编码英文文本更改的令牌数量;每令牌正常化的PPL增加,而每字节正常化的BPB则适度增长. BPB是保留原能力的主要衡量标准。

blocks.en: Three observations follow from BPB. First, model size in the range 82 82 M– 355 355 M does not reduce forgetting: GPT-2 medium ( 355 355 M, 1.99 × 1.99\times ) degrades at the level of DistilGPT2 ( 82 82 M, 1.83 × 1.83\times ), and GPT-2 base ( 124 124 M) degrades the most ( 2.08 × 2.08\times ). Forgetting is determined by the domain shift of pretraining rather than by model capacity. Second, degradation on English and Russian differs: English BPB grows by a factor of 1.8 1.8 – 2.1 2.1 , Russian by a factor of 1.06 1.06 – 1.21 1.21 . The reason is the overlap of the Cyrillic vocabularies of Bashkir and Russian: fine-tuning on Bashkir does not displace Russian BPE tokens from the distribution, whereas it does displace English ones. Third, forgetting correlates with the proportion of target tokens (Table 2 ): GPT-2 medium, with the lowest proportion of Bashkir tokens ( 0.271 0.271 ), shows the greatest switching to English during generation.
blocks.zh: BPB提出了三项意见。 首先,82 82 M– 355 355 M的模型尺寸不会减少遗忘:GPT-2介质(355 355 M,1.99 × 1.99\时)在DistilGPT2(82 82 M,1.83 × 1.83\时)的水平下降解,GPT-2碱基(124 124 M)降解得最多(2.08×2.08\时). 遗忘是由预训的域位转移决定的,而不是由模型能力决定的. 第二,英语和俄语的降解不同:英语的BPB增长系数为1.81.8–2.12.1,俄语的降解系数为1.061.06–1.211.21. 原因是巴什基尔语和俄语的西里尔语词汇重叠:对巴什基尔语的微调不会取代发行时的俄罗斯BPE符号,而确实取代英语符号. 第三,遗忘与目标标志比例相关(表2):GPT-2介质,巴什基尔标志比例最低(0.271 0.271),显示在一代人中,对英语的转换最大.

blocks.en: QLoRA on 7 7 – 8 8 B models (Table 2 ) preserves a Bashkir proportion of 0.59 0.59 – 0.60 0.60 without updating the original weights and is not subject to the observed forgetting. A direct comparison of forgetting between Full FT and QLoRA was not performed: the QLoRA experiments used a single seed and did not save per-example NLL for EN/RU (Section 6.5 ).
blocks.zh: QLORA在7 7 – 8 8 B型车(表2)上保留了巴什基尔比例0.59 0.59 – 0.60 0.60而不更新原始重量,并且不受观察到的遗忘的影响. 没有直接比较FT和QLORA之间的遗忘:QLORA实验使用了单一的种子,没有为EN/RU节省每例NLL(第6.5节)。

blocks.en: CPT reduces perplexity by 0.33 0.33 points for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B and by 0.58 0.58 points for Phi-3-mini; after Holm–Bonferroni correction, both differences are significant ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), and the effect size Cliff’s δ \delta corresponds to large. For Mistral-7B, CPT increases perplexity by 1.15 1.15 points; the effect is also significant ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 , Cliff’s δ \delta large, negative sign). The direction of the CPT effect on perplexity differs across models: CPT improves language modelling for Phi-3-mini and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B and worsens it for Mistral-7B.
blocks.zh: CPT将YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B的偏差降低0.330.33分,Phi-3-mini的偏差降低0.580.58分;Holm-Bonferroni校正后,两者差异都相当大(p < 0.001 p<0.001]),而Cliff 的效果大小 \\\ delta 对应于大. 对Mistral-7B来说,CPT增加了1. 15 1. 15点;效果也很大(p < 0.001 p < 0.001, Cliff的\ delta大,阴性标志). blocks.en: On the binary classification task (Section 4.3 ), the CPT effect has a different direction. YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B shows the same macro-F1 in both configurations ( 0.748 0.748 with CPT and 0.748 0.748 without); Mistral-7B gains + 4.0 +4.0 points ( 0.681 → 0.721 0.681\to 0.721 ); Phi-3-mini gains + 2.7 +2.7 points ( 0.674 → 0.701 0.674\to 0.701 ). For Mistral-7B, the directions of the CPT effect on LM and on downstream classification are opposite: perplexity increases by 1.15 1.15 points, while macro-F1 increases by 4.0 4.0 points. For Phi-3-mini and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, both effects are positive or neutral.
blocks.zh: 关于二进制分类任务(第4.3节),CPT效应有不同的方向. YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B在两种配置中都显示相同的宏F1(0.748与CPT和0.748 0.748不);Mistral-7B增益+4.0+4.0分(0.681~0.781~0.721);Phi-3-mini增益+2.7+2.7分(0.674~0.674~0.701). 对于Mistral-7B来说,CPT对LM和下游分类的影响方向是相反的:复杂度增加1.15分,而宏观-F1增加4.04.0分. 对于Phi-3-mini和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B来说,这两种效果都是正中或中性的.

blocks.en: On the multiclass classification task (Section 4.4 ), CPT yields a macro-F1 gain for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( 0.332 → 0.366 0.332\to 0.366 , + 0.034 +0.034 ) and Phi-3-mini ( 0.154 → 0.166 0.154\to 0.166 , + 0.012 +0.012 ), and a decrease for Mistral-7B ( 0.298 → 0.283 0.298\to 0.283 , − 0.015 -0.015 ).

The CPT effect depends on the base model and the task. On perplexity, CPT is positive for Phi-3-mini and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B and negative for Mistral-7B. On binary classification, CPT is positive for Mistral-7B and Phi-3-mini and neutral for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B. On multiclass classification, CPT is positive for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B and Phi-3-mini and negative for Mistral-7B. Improvement in language modelling does not translate unambiguously into improvement in classification. Separation of the effects of CPT and downstream training (for example, evaluating classification only after the CPT adapter, without QLoRA) was not performed in this work.
blocks.zh: CPT效应取决于基础模型和任务. 在复杂度方面,CPT对Phi-3-mini和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B呈阳性,对Mistral-7B呈阴性. 在二进制分类上,CPT对Mistral-7B和Phi-3-mini为阳性,对YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B为中性. 在多类分类上,CPT对YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B和Phi-3-mini为阳性,对Mistral-7B为阴性. 语言建模的改进并没有明确地转化为分类的改进。 在这项工作中,没有将欧洲防止酷刑委员会的效果与下游培训区分开来(例如,只在欧洲防止酷刑委员会适配器之后评估分类,没有QLORA)。

blocks.en: The difference between the two QLoRA configurations without CPT (step6, r = 8 r=8 ; step4, r = 16 r=16 ) for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B is 0.012 0.012 ( 0.736 0.736 versus 0.748 0.748 ) in favour of the larger rank. For Mistral-7B and Phi-3-mini the difference is opposite ( 0.709 0.709 versus 0.681 0.681 ; 0.702 0.702 versus 0.674 0.674 ). The result diverges from the observation in Burnashev et al. blocks.en: 4.6 Generation Quality: LLM-as-Judge

blocks.en: To assess generation quality, three LLM judges were applied (pollux-judge-7b, M-Prometheus-7B, saiga_llama3_8b). On 126 generated texts (from 6 to 23 per model), three evaluation modes were conducted: direct scoring (1–5 on the criteria grammar, coherence, language), granular decomposition (morphology, lexicon, syntax) and pairwise ranking with control for presentation order. The results of direct scoring and pairwise ranking are presented in Table 12 .

blocks.en: In direct scoring mode, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B leads on grammar ( 2.89 2.89 ), Mistral-7B on coherence ( 2.44 2.44 ), and GPT-2 base on language correctness ( 2.66 2.66 ). The differences between the three leading models on grammar are 2.75 2.75 – 2.89 2.89 . blocks.en: In pairwise ranking mode, the highest win rate is for Mistral-7B (win rate 0.529 0.529 , 18 18 wins and 0 0 losses out of 34 34 comparisons), followed by YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( 0.444 0.444 , 16 16 / 0 0 out of 36 36 ), Phi-3-mini ( 0.353 0.353 , 12 12 /5), DistilGPT2 ( 0.265 0.265 , 9 9 /4), GPT-2 base ( 0.026 0.026 , 1 1 / 23 23 ) and GPT-2 medium ( 0.026 0.026 , 1 1 / 25 25 ). The proportion of ties for all models is 12 12 – 21 21 out of 34 34 – 38 38 comparisons: the judges frequently express no preference for either text.

In pairwise ranking, Mistral-7B outperforms YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B; in direct scoring and in native-speaker ratings (Section 4.7 ), YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B outperforms Mistral-7B. The discrepancy is explained by the sensitivity of pairwise comparison to length and style: in the absence of length control, pairs of Mistral-7B versus YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B may be biased towards longer texts. The sample of pairs was not controlled for length; the pairwise comparison is interpreted as an additional signal.
blocks.zh: 在对称排名中,Mistral-7B的成绩优于YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B;在直接得分和本地语的收视率(第4.7节)中,YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B的成绩优于Mistral-7B. 差异的原因是对长度和样式的对称比较的敏感性:在没有长度控制的情况下,Mistral-7B对YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B的对称可能会偏向较长的文本. 对偶的样本没有控制长度;对偶比较被解释为额外的信号.

blocks.en: The results of granular decomposition (morphology, lexicon, syntax) are given in the replication package ( granular.json ); in the main text they are not aggregated into a single metric and are not used for cross-model comparison. Spearman’s correlation between the granular and direct criteria on the same 126 generations is ρ = 0.60 \rho=0.60 for the morphology–grammar pair ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), ρ = 0.22 \rho=0.22 for lexicon–language ( p = 0.014 p=0.014 ) and ρ = 0.22 \rho=0.22 for syntax–coherence ( p = 0.014 p=0.014 ). A moderate correlation of morphology with grammar is expected: both metrics record inflection. A weak correlation of lexicon with language fluency and of syntax with coherence indicates that the granular criteria record aspects of quality not fully covered by direct scoring: lexical choice and word order are less well captured by a general assessment of language fluency. Since the granular scores are not aggregated in this work, they are presented in the replication package as auxiliary.

blocks.en: 4.9 Variance Decomposition
blocks.zh: 4.9 差额

blocks.en: To estimate the relative contribution of architecture, adaptation method and random seed, a one-way analysis of variance was applied to each group. The results for the key metrics are given in Table 17 . The factors ‘model’ and ‘method’ in the current configuration are confounded: GPT-2 family models (three architectures) were trained only by full fine-tuning, whereas the 3.8 3.8 – 8 8 B generative models (three architectures) were trained only by QLoRA. Therefore η method 2 \eta^{2}_{\text{method}} should be interpreted as the effect of the group ‘small Full FT versus large QLoRA’, rather than as a pure effect of the adaptation method; separating these effects requires a crossed experimental design (Full FT and QLoRA on the same architectures).
blocks.zh: 为估计建筑、适应方法和随机种子的相对贡献,对每组差异进行了单向分析。 关键指标的结果见表17。 目前配置中的 " 模式 " 和 " 方法 " 因素令人困惑:GPT-2家族模式(三个架构)仅经过全面微调培训,而3.8 – 8 8 B基因模式(三个架构)仅由QLORA培训。 因此,方法2\eta=2\text{方法}应解释为“小FT对大QLORA”的效果,而不是适应方法的纯效果;区分这些效果需要交叉实验设计(FUL FT和QLORA在同一架构上)。

blocks.en: Table 17: Decomposition of variance ( η 2 \eta^{2} ) for the key metrics
blocks.zh: 表17:关键指标差异的分解(2\eta=2})

blocks.en: For PPL, the adaptation method explains 73 % 73\,\% of the variance ( η 2 = 0.73 \eta^{2}=0.73 , p = 0.002 p=0.002 ), architecture — 54 % 54\,\% ( η 2 = 0.54 \eta^{2}=0.54 , p = 0.16 p=0.16 , not significant), seed — 13 % 13\,\% ( η 2 = 0.13 \eta^{2}=0.13 , p = 0.18 p=0.18 , not significant). For BPB the picture is analogous: method 72 % 72\,\% ( p = 0.002 p=0.002 ), architecture 36 % 36\,\% ( p = 0.46 p=0.46 ), seed 5 % 5\,\% ( p = 0.43 p=0.43 ). The reverse pattern is observed for the proportion of target tokens: 81 % 81\,\% of the variance is explained by architecture ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), method contributes 27 % 27\,\% ( p = 0.15 p=0.15 , not significant), seed 8 % 8\,\% ( p = 0.47 p=0.47 , not significant).

Such a decomposition indicates that the adaptation strategy dominates in explaining perplexity and BPB, whereas architecture dominates in explaining language alignment (the proportion of target tokens). This is consistent with the hypothesis that language alignment is determined primarily by the composition of the pretraining and by the tokeniser, whereas perplexity is determined by the adaptation strategy.
blocks.zh: 这种分解表明,适应战略在解释模糊性和BPB方面占主导地位,而结构则在解释语言一致性(目标符号的比例)方面占主导地位。 这与以下假设是一致的:语言统一主要取决于预训的构成和象征,而迷惑性则取决于适应战略。

blocks.en: It should be noted that with n = 15 n=15 observations for PPL/BPB and n = 9 n=9 for the proportion of target tokens, the analysis of variance has limited power; the results should be interpreted as preliminary. In particular, for PPL the contribution of architecture ( η 2 = 0.54 \eta^{2}=0.54 ) does not reach the significance level ( p = 0.16 p=0.16 ) at the given sample, although the effect size is large. Final conclusions require expanding the number of configurations (primarily, adding additional random seeds), which constitutes a direction for further work.
blocks.zh: 需要注意的是,用n=15n=15的PPL/BPB观测结果,和n=9n=9的目标信使比例,差异分析的功率有限;结果应解释为初步的. 尤其是,对于PPL来说,架构的贡献(η2 = 0.54\eta^{2}=0.54)并没有在给定的样本中达到意义级(p = 0.16 p=0.16),尽管效果大小很大. 最后结论要求扩大配置数量(主要是增加额外的随机种子),这构成下一步工作的方向.

blocks.en: 5.1 Factors Behind the Superiority of YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B
blocks.zh: 5.1 YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B优越性背后的因素

blocks.en: YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B outperforms the other models across the set of downstream metrics. A robust advantage, confirmed statistically, is established on multiclass classification ( 0.368 0.368 in step6 versus 0.292 0.292 for Mistral-7B and 0.119 0.119 for Phi-3-mini, McNemar p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 for both pairs; Table 8 ), on BPB ( 0.462 0.462 versus 0.549 0.549 and 0.704 0.704 ; Table 3 , p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 ) and on native-speaker ratings (mean 3.28 3.28 versus 2.52 2.52 and 2.22 2.22 , p Holm < 0.05 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.05 ; Table 13 ). On zero-shot ICL a point advantage is observed ( 0.580 0.580 – 0.679 0.679 versus 0.360 0.360 – 0.482 0.482 and 0.400 0.400 – 0.513 0.513 macro-F1; Table 10 ), although no formal test was conducted for this metric in the present work. On binary classification the point advantage of YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (step6 = 0.736 =0.736 , step4 with CPT = 0.748 =0.748 versus 0.681 0.681 – 0.721 0.721 for Mistral-7B and 0.674 0.674 – 0.702 0.702 for Phi-3-mini, Table 6 ) is also not confirmed statistically within the step6 QLoRA group: Yandex vs Mistral p Holm = 0.183 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.183 , Yandex vs Phi-3 p Holm = 0.084 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.084 (Table 7 ). Among the metrics suitable for cross-model comparison, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B is inferior to Mistral-7B only on the pairwise win rate of LLM judges ( 0.444 0.444 versus 0.529 0.529 , Table 12 ); as shown in Section 4.7 , this discrepancy is explained by the peculiarities of the pairwise mode rather than by model quality. PPL is not among these metrics: by PPL YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B is inferior to Mistral-7B ( 3.29 3.29 versus 2.90 2.90 , Table 2 ), but PPL is unsuitable for cross-model comparison under different tokenisers (Section 6.5 ).
