blocks.en: Two reasons for the superiority of YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B follow from the analysis of tokenisers and pretraining. The first is a Cyrillic tokeniser with a lower fertility rate: 3.80 3.80 subtokens per Bashkir word versus 7.80 7.80 for the GPT-2 family ( 2.05 2.05 times, Table 15 ). A smaller number of subtokens per word form means greater character coverage by each token, and the model uses the limited context length more efficiently ( 128 128 tokens in the experiments). The second reason is Russian-language pretraining: Russian uses Cyrillic and has agglutinative features, which gives the model partial morphological priors for Bashkir. An indirect argument in favour of this interpretation is the performance of YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B in zero-shot ICL: macro-F1 0.657 0.657 – 0.679 0.679 in Russian and English (in Bashkir 0.580 0.580 , Table 10 ), which is expected for a model with a Cyrillic tokeniser and closely related morphology.
blocks.zh: YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B的优越性有两个原因,这些原因来自于对代号和预训的分析. 第一种是西里尔语代币,生育率较低:每个巴什基尔语为3.803.80次,而GPT-2家庭为7.80次(2.05次,表15)。 每个字形的潜物数量较少,意味着每个符号的字符覆盖范围更大,模型更高效地使用有限的上下文长度(实验中128个128个符号). 第二个原因是俄语预训:俄语使用西里尔语,并具有加固特征,这为巴什基尔提供了模型部分形态学前科. 支持这一解释的一个间接论据是YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B在零镜头ICL中的性能:macro-F1 0.657 0.657 – 0.679 0.679 在俄语和英语中(在Bashkir 0.580 0.580,表10),对于一个带有西里尔语象征语和密切相关的形态学的模型,预计其性能.

blocks.en: A comparison with the GPT-2 family captures both reasons simultaneously. YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (8B, fertility 3.80 3.80 ) outperforms GPT-2 medium (355M, fertility 7.80 7.80 ) by 1.92 1.92 points on the mean native-speaker rating ( 3.28 3.28 versus 1.36 1.36 ) with a 22 22 -fold difference in the number of parameters; fertility for Yandex is lower by a factor of 2.05 2.05 . Increasing the number of parameters with an unchanged tokeniser yields no gain: GPT-2 medium (355M) is inferior to DistilGPT2 (82M) on native-speaker ratings ( 1.36 1.36 versus 1.75 1.75 ) with the same BPE vocabulary. The comparison with Phi-3-mini is less informative for the fertility hypothesis: Phi-3-mini (3.8B) is inferior to YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (8B) by 1.06 1.06 points ( 2.22 2.22 versus 3.28 3.28 ), but the fertility of Phi-3-mini was not measured in the present work, and the gap cannot be attributed directly to fertility. The observed picture is consistent with the hypothesis that the tokeniser and the language composition of pretraining contribute more to adaptation quality than model size in the 3.8 3.8 – 8 8 B range.
blocks.zh: 与GPT-2家族的比较可以同时捕捉两个原因. YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(8B,生育率3.80 3.80)在平均母语者评分(3.28 3.28比1.36)上比GPT-2中位数(355M,生育率7.80 7.80)高出1.92分,参数数差22倍;Yandex的生育率比2.052.05的系数低。 增加一个不变的代号的参数数不产生收益:GPT-2介质(355M)在本地语的收视率(1.361.36比1.751.75)上低于DistilGPT2(82M),其BPE词汇相同. 与Phi-3-mini的比较对生育假说信息较少:Phi-3-mini(3.8B)低于YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(8B),比1.061.06分(2.222.22比3.283.28),但Phi-3-mini的生育力在目前的工作中没有被测量,差距不能直接归因于生育力. 观测到的画面与预训的标语和语言构成比3.8-8 8 B范围的模型尺寸更有助于适应质量的假设是一致的.

blocks.en: 5.2 The Selective Effect of Continual Pretraining
blocks.zh: 5.2 连续预先训练的选择性效果

blocks.en: The effect of continual pretraining on the Bashkir corpus (10,000 documents, 1 epoch, LoRA r = 16 r=16 , lr = 10 − 5 \text{lr}=10^{-5} ) differs across three metrics: perplexity, binary and multiclass classification. None of the metrics gives a single ranking of models by the benefit of CPT, and this discrepancy is a substantive result of the work.
blocks.zh: 持续预训对巴什基尔教程的影响(10 000份文件,1个纪元,LORA r = 16 r = 16,lr = 10 − 5\text{lr}=10^{-5})在三个衡量标准上有所不同:模糊性,二进制和多类分类. 没有一个衡量标准通过CPT的好处给出了单一的模型排名,这种差异是工作的实质性结果.

blocks.en: Perplexity. By PPL, CPT is positive for Phi-3-mini ( Δ \Delta PPL = + 0.58 =+0.58 , p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 , Cliff’s δ \delta large) and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( Δ \Delta PPL = + 0.33 =+0.33 , p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 , Cliff’s δ \delta large) and significantly negative for Mistral-7B ( Δ \Delta PPL = − 1.15 =-1.15 , p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 , Cliff’s δ \delta large, negative sign; Table 5 ). The direction of the PPL effect differs across models: CPT improves language modelling for Phi-3-mini and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B and worsens it for Mistral-7B. For the two models with a positive effect, the gain is small in absolute value ( 0.33 0.33 – 0.58 0.58 PPL points), which indicates a limited benefit of CPT in the current configuration: a larger gain would require either more data (10,000 documents is 14 % 14\,\% of the full corpus of 71,567 documents), or more epochs, or a higher learning rate. The observed selectivity is consistent with the hypothesis about the role of the volume of English-language pretraining: Mistral-7B was trained on a substantially larger English-language corpus and presumably has more stable representations, which the conservative learning rate ( 10 − 5 10^{-5} ) does not shift towards Bashkir in one epoch; for Phi-3-mini and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B the same shift yields a positive effect. In absolute magnitude, Δ \Delta PPL for Mistral-7B ( 1.15 1.15 points) is larger than for Phi-3-mini and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( 0.58 0.58 and 0.33 0.33 ), but with the opposite sign.
blocks.zh: 迷惑众生. PPL认为,CPT对Phi-3-mini(\Delta PPL = + 0.58 = 0.58 = 0.58 = = 0.58 = = 0.58 = = 0.58 = 0.58 pholm = 0.001 p_{\tex{Holm}}<0.001, 克里夫·PPL = = 0.15 = = 0.001 p_{\tex{Holm}}<0.001, 克里夫 = = = = 负兆;表5)是肯定的。 PPL效应的方向在不同的模型上有所不同:CPT改进了Phi-3-mini和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B的语言建模,使Mistral-7B更形恶化. 对于两个具有正面效果的模型,收益的绝对值很小(0.33 0.33 – 0.58 PPL点),这表明CPT在目前配置中的好处有限:更大的收益需要更多的数据(10,000份文件是71,567文件总量的14% 14\ ) , 或更多时代,或更高学习率. 所观察到的选择性与关于英文预训量作用的假设是一致的: Mistral-7B接受了关于大得多的英语教程的培训,并假定其表述更加稳定,保守的学习率(10 - 5 10 - 5 )并没有转向 Bashkir在一个时代;对于Phi-3-mini和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B来说,同样的转变会产生积极的效果。 在绝对星等上,Mistral-7B的QQ\Delta PPL(1.15分)大于Phi-3-mini和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(0.58分0.58分和0.33分0.33分),但带有相反的标志.

blocks.en: Binary classification. On the binary task (Section 4.3 ) the picture is different: CPT improves macro-F1 for Mistral-7B ( 0.681 → 0.721 0.681\to 0.721 , + 4.0 +4.0 points) and Phi-3-mini ( 0.674 → 0.701 0.674\to 0.701 , + 2.7 +2.7 points) and does not change the result for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( 0.748 0.748 in both configurations). The largest gain here is observed for Mistral-7B, the very model for which CPT significantly worsened perplexity. Thus, the hypothesis that ‘CPT helps models with a smaller volume of multilingual pretraining’, which holds for PPL, is not confirmed on binary classification: CPT helps precisely Mistral-7B with the largest English-language pretraining.
blocks.zh: 二进制分类. 关于二进制任务(第4.3节),画面不同:CPT改进了宏-F1,用于Mistral-7B(0.681 → 0.721 0.681\to 0.721,+ 4.0+4.0分)和Phi-3-mini(0.674 → 0.701 0.674\to 0.701,+ 2.7+2.7分),并不改变YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(两者配置均为0.748 0.748分)的结果. 这里最大的收益是观测到的Mistral-7B,而正是这种模式,CPT大大加剧了其复杂性。 因此,持有PPL的`CPT帮助多语种预训量较小的模型 ' 的假设在二进制分类上没有得到确认:CPT帮助精确地说Mistral-7B帮助了最大的英语预训.

blocks.en: Multiclass classification. On the multiclass task (Section 4.4 ) the CPT effect is heterogeneous. When compared within the step4 configuration (rank r = 16 r=16 ), CPT yields a macro-F1 gain for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( 0.332 → 0.366 0.332\to 0.366 , + 0.034 +0.034 ) and Phi-3-mini ( 0.154 → 0.166 0.154\to 0.166 , + 0.012 +0.012 ), but worsens it for Mistral-7B ( 0.298 → 0.283 0.298\to 0.283 , − 0.015 -0.015 ). Here CPT is positive for the same two models as on perplexity and negative for Mistral-7B, which is consistent with the hypothesis about the role of the volume of pretraining. A possible explanation for the negative effect for Mistral-7B is the strong class imbalance ( 47.5 % 47.5\,\% of documents belong to one category), under which the signal from CPT is diluted by the dominant class; for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B and Phi-3-mini, by contrast, CPT yields a measurable gain.

Summary. Taken together, the three metrics show that the benefit of CPT depends on both the base model and the task: on perplexity CPT is positive for Phi-3-mini and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B and significantly negative for Mistral-7B; on binary classification, by contrast, CPT gives the largest gain precisely for Mistral-7B; on multiclass classification CPT is positive for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B and Phi-3-mini and negative for Mistral-7B. A possible explanation for the discrepancy is the different sensitivity of perplexity and downstream quality to the shift of representations under CPT: an improvement in language modelling does not necessarily translate into an improvement in classification, and vice versa. A final conclusion on the benefit of CPT requires separating the effects of CPT and downstream training (for example, evaluating classification only after the CPT adapter, without QLoRA), which was not done in the present work, as well as systematic variation of the learning rate and the volume of CPT data.
blocks.zh: 总结. 综上所述,三个衡量标准都表明,CPT的好处取决于基准模型和任务:CPT对于Phi-3-mini和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B来说是积极的,对于Mistral-7B来说是明显的负的;相对而言,CPT对于二进制分类来说是最大的收益,对于Mistral-7B来说是最大的;对于YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B和Phi-3-mini来说是积极的,对于Mistral-7B来说是否定的。 对差异的一个可能的解释是,在CPT下,对表达方式的转变,复杂性和下游质量的敏感性不同:语言建模的改进并不一定转化为分类的改进,反之亦然. 关于欧洲防止酷刑委员会益处的最后结论要求将欧洲防止酷刑委员会的效果与下游培训分开(例如,只在欧洲防止酷刑委员会适配器之后评价分类,没有QLORA),而目前的工作没有这样做,还需要系统地改变欧洲防止酷刑委员会的学习速度和数据量。

blocks.en: 5.3 Divergence Between LLM-as-Judge Modes and Native Speakers
blocks.zh: 5.3 LLM-as-Judge Modes与土著语使用者之间的差异

blocks.en: A comparison of three sources of generation quality assessment — LLM judges in direct scoring mode, LLM judges in pairwise ranking mode, and native Bashkir speakers — reveals systematic discrepancies that should be taken into account when interpreting the results.
blocks.zh: 对三个生成质量评估来源的比较——直接评分模式的LLM评委、双向排名模式的LLM评委和本地的Bashkir演讲者——显示出在解释结果时应考虑的系统性差异。

blocks.en: The first discrepancy is between direct scoring and pairwise ranking. In direct scoring, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B leads on grammar ( 2.89 2.89 versus 2.83 2.83 for Mistral-7B), whereas in pairwise ranking it is inferior ( 0.444 0.444 versus 0.529 0.529 , Table 12 ). At the same time, native speakers rate YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B significantly higher than Mistral-7B on all three criteria ( Δ grammar = + 0.82 \Delta_{\text{grammar}}=+0.82 , Δ coherence = + 0.91 \Delta_{\text{coherence}}=+0.91 , Δ language = + 0.58 \Delta_{\text{language}}=+0.58 , p Holm < 0.05 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.05 , Section 4.7 ). Thus, pairwise ranking by LLM judges yields a ranking opposite to direct scoring and native-speaker ratings. The most likely reason is the absence of length control in the pairs: without explicit normalisation of text length, the judge tends to prefer the longer generation, and this bias may override the difference in language quality. For low-resource languages this means that pairwise ranking by LLM judges without length control should not be used as the primary signal.
blocks.zh: 第一个差异在于直接得分和双向排名. 在直接评分中,YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B领先于语法(Mistral-7B的2.89 2.89比2.83 2.83),而在对位排名中则低(0.444 0.44比0.529 0.529,表12). 同时,土著语者对所有三个标准(QQ语法=+0.82\Delta_{\tex{grammar}}=+0.82,+0.91\Delta_{\tex{coherence}}=+0.91,++0.58\Delta_{\tex{语言}}=+{0.58,pholm < 0.05 p_{\tex{Holm}}<0.05,section 4.7)的评分为YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B明显高于Mistral-7B. 因此,LLM评委的双向排名得出了与直接评分和母语评分相反的排名. 最可能的原因是配对中缺乏长度控制:没有文本长度的明确正常化,法官倾向于选择更长的一代,这种偏差可能压倒语言质量的差异. 对低资源语言而言,这意味着LLM法官在没有长度控制的情况下进行对等排名不应作为主要信号。

blocks.en: The second discrepancy is between direct scoring by LLM judges and native-speaker ratings. The means of the LLM judges lie in the range 1.89 1.89 – 2.89 2.89 (width 1.00 1.00 ), whereas the means of the native speakers lie in the range 1.16 1.16 – 3.82 3.82 (width 2.66 2.66 , 2.7 2.7 times wider). LLM judges compress the scale towards the middle and underestimate the gap between the best and worst models: by LLM judges YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B outperforms GPT-2 medium on grammar by 0.76 0.76 points ( 2.89 2.89 versus 2.13 2.13 ), by native speakers by 1.78 1.78 points ( 2.94 2.94 versus 1.16 1.16 ). Similarly, on the language criterion LLM judges place GPT-2 base ( 2.66 2.66 ) above YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( 2.56 2.56 ), whereas native speakers do the opposite ( 2.33 2.33 versus 3.82 3.82 ). This indicates that multilingual LLM judges (pollux-judge-7b, M-Prometheus-7B, saiga_llama3_8b), trained predominantly on Russian and English, are insufficiently sensitive to Bashkir-language fluency proper.
blocks.zh: 第二个差异是LLM评委直接评分和本地语评分. LLM裁判员的手段在1.89 1.89 – 2.89 2.89(宽1.00 1.00)之间,而母语裁判员的手段在1.16 1.16 3.82 3.82(宽2.66 2.66,宽2.7倍)。 LLM评委压缩尺度向中间倾斜,低估最佳模式与最差模式之间的差距: LLM评委 YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B在语法上以0.76 0.76分(2.89 2.89比2.13 2.13)优于GPT-2介质,由母语人以1.78 1.78分(2.94 2.94比1.16 1.16)表示. 同样,在语言标准方面,LLM法官将GPT-2基数(2.66 2.66)置于YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(2.56 2.56)之上,而母语则相反(2.33 2.33比3.82 3.82)。 这表明,主要接受俄语和英语培训的多语言LLM法官(Pollux-judge-7b、M-Prometheus-7B、saiga_llama3_8b)对巴什基尔语流利性本身不够敏感。

blocks.en: The third discrepancy is the statistical non-significance of the correlation between LLM judges and native speakers on the language criterion ( ρ = 0.162 \rho=0.162 , p = 0.11 p=0.11 , Section 4.7 ). At the same time, on grammar ( ρ = 0.462 \rho=0.462 ) and coherence ( ρ = 0.334 \rho=0.334 ) the correlation is significant ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). This means that LLM judges reproduce human ratings when assessing formal-grammatical aspects, but not when assessing language correctness as such. For low-resource languages, where no LLM judges trained on the target language are available, native-speaker evaluation remains necessary for the language criterion; direct scoring by LLM judges can be used as an additional signal on grammar and coherence.
blocks.zh: 第三个差异是语言标准上LLM法官与本地语法官之间关联性的统计学上无意义(^ 0.162\rho=0.162,p=0.11 p=0.11,第4.7节). 同时,关于语法(ρ=0.462\rho=0.462)和一致性(ρ=0.334\rho=0.334),相关关系是显著的(p < 0.001 p < 0.001),这意味着LLM在评估正式语法方面时判断复制人类的评级,但在评估语言正确性时并非如此. 对于资源不足的语言,如果没有受过目标语言培训的LLM法官,语言标准仍需要本地语评估;LLM法官直接评分可以用作语法和一致性的额外信号.

blocks.en: 5.4 Tokenisation as a Source of Digital Inequality
blocks.zh: 5.4 作为数字不平等来源的托肯化

blocks.en: The relationship between the fertility rate of a tokeniser and adaptation quality can be traced in three metrics. The fertility rate on Bashkir varies from 2.92 2.92 (T-lite-2.1) to 7.80 7.80 (the GPT-2 family and Phi-2), that is, by a factor of 2.67 2.67 (Table 15 ). All three GPT-2 family models use a single BPE vocabulary with fertility 7.80 7.80 ; Phi-2 inherits the same vocabulary. YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( 3.80 3.80 ) and Mistral-7B ( 4.81 4.81 ) use vocabularies covering Cyrillic and Turkic morphology.
blocks.zh: 标致器的生育率与适应质量之间的关系可追溯到三个度量. 巴什基尔的生育率从2.922.92(T-lite-2.1)到7.80(GPT-2家族和Phi-2)不等,即比2.672.67(表15)。 所有三个GPT-2家族模型都使用一个具有7.80 7.80生育率的单一BPE词汇;Phi-2继承了相同的词汇. YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(3.80 3.80)和米斯特拉尔-7B(4.81 4.81)使用词汇,涵盖西里尔语和突厥语形态.

blocks.en: The relationship with quality manifests itself in three metrics. By BPB, the GPT-2 family models show 0.784 0.784 – 0.917 0.917 , whereas YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B shows 0.462 0.462 and Mistral-7B 0.549 0.549 (Table 2 ): with fertility 7.80 7.80 , representing the same text requires more tokens, which complicates the modelling of long dependencies. By native-speaker ratings, the GPT-2 family models receive 1.16 1.16 – 1.48 1.48 on grammar versus 2.94 2.94 for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (Table 13 ). In pairwise ranking, GPT-2 base and GPT-2 medium win 1 1 out of 38 38 comparisons each, whereas YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B and Mistral-7B lose none (Table 12 ).
blocks.zh: 与质量的关系表现在三个标准上. 根据BPB,GPT-2家庭模式显示为0.784 0.784 – 0.917 0.917,而 YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B显示为0.462 0.462和Mistral-7B 0.549 0.549(表2):生育率为7.80 7.80,代表同一文本需要更多的符号,这使得长期依赖的建模复杂化. 根据母语收视率,GPT-2家庭模式获得1.16 1.16 — 1.48 1.48的语法成绩,而YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B的成绩则为2.94 2.94(表13)。 在对位排名中,GPT-2基础和GPT-2介质各获得38个比较中的1个,而YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B和Mistral-7B则没有损失(表12).

blocks.en: The relationship is not deterministic. T-lite-2.1 has the lowest fertility ( 2.92 2.92 ) but did not participate in the downstream experiments; Qwen2.5-7B ( 4.23 4.23 ) also did not participate. Phi-3-mini participated in the downstream experiments, but its fertility rate was not measured in the present work: the tokeniser of Phi-3-mini differs from that of Phi-2, and the value 7.80 7.80 is not applicable to it. The correlation is established on five models with measured fertility and downstream results: YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, Mistral-7B, GPT-2 base, GPT-2 medium, DistilGPT2.
blocks.zh: 这种关系不是决定性的。 T-lite-2.1的生育率最低(2.92 2.92 ),但没有参加下游实验;Quen2.5-7B(4.23 4.23 )也没有参加. Phi-3-mini参加了下游实验,但其生育率在本作中没有被测量:Phi-3-mini的表示器与Phi-2的表示器不同,其价值7.807.80不适用. 与衡量生育率和下游结果的五个模型建立了相关性: YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B,米斯特拉尔-7B,GPT-2基,GPT-2介质,DistilGPT2.

blocks.en: Control on Turkish confirms the interpretation. Turkish is an agglutinative language with Latin script and medium-resource status; in Turkish the fertility rate for all six models in the table lies in the range 3.00 3.00 – 3.75 3.75 (spread 1.25 1.25 times), whereas in Bashkir it is 2.92 2.92 – 7.80 7.80 (spread 2.67 2.67 times). In English (high-resource) the spread is lower: 1.26 1.26 – 1.37 1.37 ( 1.09 1.09 times). The discrepancy is consistent with the hypothesis that the source is the low-resource status of Bashkir rather than agglutinative morphology or non-standard script as such. The ratio fertility ba {}_{\text{ba}} /fertility tr {}_{\text{tr}} , which measures the penalty for low-resource status under fixed agglutinative morphology, orders the three models identically to downstream quality on the binary task: GPT-2 ( 2.18 2.18 , macro-F1 0.699 0.699 ) < < Mistral-7B ( 1.28 1.28 , 0.721 0.721 ) < < YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( 1.18 1.18 , 0.748 0.748 ).
blocks.zh: 对土耳其语的控制证实了这一解释。 土耳其语是一种带有拉丁文文字和中等资源状态的格调语言;在土耳其语中,表中所有六个模型的生育率在3.003.00-3.75-3.75(扩展1.25倍)之间,而在巴什基尔是2.922.92-7.807.80(扩展2.672.67倍)。 英语(高资源)的传播率较低:1.26 1.26 – 1.37 1.37(1.09 1.09倍). 这种差异与以下假设是一致的:来源是巴什基尔的低资源状态,而不是副状形态或非标准脚本本身. 衡量固定卵巢形态下低资源状况的处罚的生育率为:GPT-2(2.18 2.18,宏F1 0.699 0.699) < Mistral-7B(1.28 1.28,0.721 0.721) < YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(1.18 1.18,0.748 0.748)。

blocks.en: Increasing the number of parameters with an unchanged tokeniser does not solve the problem of digital inequality. GPT-2 medium (355M) is inferior to DistilGPT2 (82M) on native-speaker ratings (mean 1.36 1.36 versus 1.75 1.75 ) with the same BPE vocabulary with fertility 7.80 7.80 . By contrast, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (8B, fertility 3.80 3.80 ) outperforms GPT-2 medium (355M, fertility 7.80 7.80 ) by 1.92 1.92 points ( 3.28 3.28 versus 1.36 1.36 ) with a 22 22 -fold difference in size: fertility for Yandex is lower by a factor of 2.05 2.05 , which explains part of the gap. Phi-3-mini (3.8B) is inferior to YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (8B) by 1.06 1.06 points ( 2.22 2.22 versus 3.28 3.28 ); the fertility of Phi-3-mini was not measured, so the gap cannot be attributed directly to fertility. For low-resource languages with agglutinative morphology and non-standard script, adapting the tokeniser — extending the vocabulary with morphemes of the target language or training BPE from scratch on the target corpus — appears a more promising direction than increasing the number of parameters with a fixed vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 增加参数数量而无变化的表示器并不能解决数字不平等问题。 GPT-2介质(355M)在本地语的收视率上低于DistilGPT2(82M)(平均1.361.36比1.751.75),具有相同的BPE词汇,生育率为7.80 7.80. 相比之下,YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(8B,生育率3.80 3.80)在GPT-2中位数(355M,生育率7.80 7.80)的成绩比1.92 1.92分(3.28 3.28比1.36 1.36),体积差22倍:Yandex的生育率比2.05 2.05的系数低,这解释了部分差距的原因. Phi-3-mini(3.8B)比YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(8B)低1.061.06分(2.222.22比3.283.28);Phi-3-mini的生育力没有被测量,因此差距不能直接归因于生育力. 对于资源匮乏且具有杂质形态和非标准脚本的语言来说,修改符号器——将词汇与目标语言的摩尔语相扩展或从目标体上从零开始培训BPE——似乎比增加有固定词汇的参数数量更有希望的方向.

blocks.en: 5.5 Practical Recommendations
blocks.zh: 5.5 实际建议

blocks.en: From the set of results, four practical recommendations can be formulated for adapting LLMs to low-resource agglutinative languages with Cyrillic script.
blocks.zh: 根据这套结果,可以拟订四项切实可行的建议,使LLMS适应使用西里尔字母的低资源附加语言。

blocks.en: Choice of base model. Under a limited computational budget, preference should be given to models with a Cyrillic tokeniser and Russian-language pretraining (in the present work, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B), even if they are inferior in the number of parameters. Across the set of six metrics (multiclass classification, BPB, native-speaker ratings, zero-shot ICL, binary classification, pairwise win rate of LLM judges), YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B outperforms both competitor models (Mistral-7B and Phi-3-mini) in 5 5 of 6 6 ; the only exception is the pairwise win rate of LLM judges ( 0.444 0.444 versus 0.529 0.529 for Mistral-7B, Section 5.3 ). On binary classification the point advantage of YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( 0.736 0.736 – 0.748 0.748 versus 0.681 0.681 – 0.721 0.721 and 0.674 0.674 – 0.702 0.702 ) is not confirmed statistically within the step6 QLoRA group ( p Holm ≥ 0.084 p_{\text{Holm}}\geq 0.084 , Table 7 ); on three of these four metrics (multiclass classification, BPB, native-speaker ratings) the superiority is confirmed statistically; for zero-shot ICL no formal test was conducted, and the conclusion is based on point estimates (gap 0.10 0.10 – 0.30 0.30 macro-F1). The T-lite-2.1 model has the lowest fertility rate in our analysis ( 2.92 2.92 , Section 4.8 ), but did not participate in the downstream experiments; its adaptation quality remains unknown and constitutes a direction for further work.
blocks.zh: 基础模型的选择. 在有限的计算预算下,应优先考虑使用西里尔符号器和俄语预训的模型(在本作中,YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B),即使它们在参数数上较低. 在整个6个衡量标准(多类分类、BPB、本地语评分、零镜头ICL、二进制分类、LLM评分双向胜率)中,YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B在6 6的5 5中都超过了竞争者模型(Mistral-7B和Phi-3-mini);唯一的例外是LLM评分双向胜率(Mistral-7B,第5.3节,0.44 0.44相对于0.529 0.529)。 关于二进制分类,YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(0.736 0.736 – 0.748 – 0.681 0.681 – 0.721 0.721 和 0.674 0.674 – 0.702 )的点优势在统计学上没有得到确认(pholm → 0.084 p_{\text{Holm}}\geq 0.084 ,表7);在这四个度量中的三个度量(多级分类,BPB,本地语者评分)的优势在统计学上得到确认;对于零镜头的ICL,没有进行正式测试,结论基于点估计(gap 0.10 – 0.30 宏-F1). T-lite-2.1模型在我们的分析中生育率最低(2.922.92,第4.8节),但没有参加下游实验;其适应质量仍然不明,是今后工作的方向。

blocks.en: Adaptation method. QLoRA with rank r = 8 r=8 yields macro-F1 0.736 0.736 on binary classification for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (Table 6 ); with CPT the same model reaches 0.748 0.748 . Both results outperform full fine-tuning of the encoder-only baselines (mBERT 0.650 0.650 , XLM-R 0.653 0.653 ) by 8.3 8.3 – 9.8 9.8 points. For classification tasks, QLoRA on 3.8 3.8 – 8 8 B models is preferable to full fine-tuning of encoder-only models.
blocks.zh: 适应方法. 排名r=8 r=8的QLORA在YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B的二进制分类上输出宏-F1 0.736 0.736(表6);使用CPT的同一型号达到0.748 0.748. 两个结果都超过了编码器唯一基准(mBERT 0.650 0.650,XLM-R 0.653 0.653)的全微调8.3 – 9.8 9.8分. 对于分类任务,3.8 3.8 – 8 8 B模型上的QLORA比完全微调编码器唯一的模型更好.

blocks.en: Continual pretraining. CPT on 10,000 documents yields a PPL gain of 0.33 0.33 – 0.58 0.58 points for Phi-3-mini and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 ) and significantly worsens PPL for Mistral-7B ( Δ = − 1.15 \Delta=-1.15 , p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 ; Table 5 ). If the base model is Mistral-7B and the target metric is perplexity, CPT in the current configuration is not justified; with a downstream orientation towards binary classification, CPT for Mistral-7B gives the largest gain ( + 4.0 +4.0 points of macro-F1). For Phi-3-mini and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, CPT is recommended as a preliminary stage.
blocks.zh: 连续预训. CPT对10000文档的PPL增益为0.33 0.33 – 0.58 0.58分,Phi-3-mini和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(pholm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001),Mistral-7B的PPL大幅恶化(Δ=− 1.15\Delta=-1.15,pholm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001;表5). 如果基准模型是Mistral-7B,而目标度量则很复杂,那么当前配置中的CPT就没有正当理由;如果下游方向是二进制分类,CPT for Mistral-7B给出的最大收益(+4.0+4.0分宏F1). 对于Phi-3-mini和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B,推荐CPT作为初步阶段.

blocks.en: Quality assessment. For low-resource languages, direct scoring by LLM judges on the criteria of grammar and coherence reproduces native-speaker ratings with moderate correlation ( ρ = 0.33 \rho=0.33 – 0.46 0.46 ), but not on the criterion of language correctness ( ρ = 0.16 \rho=0.16 , p = 0.11 p=0.11 , Section 4.7 ). Pairwise ranking without length control may yield a ranking opposite to direct scoring and native-speaker ratings (Section 4.6 ) and should not be used as the primary signal. Native-speaker evaluation remains necessary for final conclusions about generation quality in Bashkir.
blocks.zh: 质量评估。 对于低资源语言,LLM评委对语法和一致性标准的直接评分,复制了具有中度相关性的土语评分(ρ=0.33\rho=0.33–0.460.46),但不在语言正确性标准上(ρ=0.16\rho=0.16,p=0.11p=0.11,第4.7节). 没有长度控制的对等排名可能会产生与直接评分和母语评分相反的排名(第4.6节),不应作为主信号使用. 对巴什基尔的发电质量作出最后结论仍有必要进行母语评价。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: This study has a number of limitations that define the scope of applicability of the conclusions and outline directions for further work. They are formulated below in descending order of significance for the interpretation of the results.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有一些局限性,界定了结论的适用范围,并概述了今后工作的方向。 下文按对解释结果重要性的依次排列。

blocks.en: 6.1 A Single Random Seed for PEFT Experiments
blocks.zh: 6.1 PEFT 实验的单随机种子

blocks.en: For the QLoRA and CPT experiments (Sections 4.3 , 4.4 , 4.2 ), a single random seed ( 42 42 ) was used; full fine-tuning (Section 4.1 ) was conducted with two seeds ( 42 42 , 123 123 ). This limits the statistical power of comparisons between PEFT configurations: the standard deviation of metrics across seeds is not estimated, and conclusions about the superiority of one QLoRA configuration over another are formulated on the basis of point estimates and bootstrap confidence intervals on the test set rather than between-seed variability. Bootstrap intervals on the test set (Tables 7 , 9 ) provide an estimate of statistical uncertainty at the level of individual examples, but not at the level of model initialisation. Confirming differences between QLoRA configurations that are close in quality (for example, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B 0.736 0.736 versus Mistral-7B 0.709 0.709 in Table 6 ; McNemar p Holm = 0.183 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.183 , Table 7 ) requires expanding the number of seeds to three or more.
blocks.zh: 对于QLORA和CPT实验(第4.3,4.4,4.2节),使用了单随机种子(42,42);用两个种子(42,42,123,123)进行了完全微调(第4.1节)。 这限制了PEFT配置对比的统计力:没有估计不同种子的度量标准偏差,关于一个QLORA配置优于另一个配置的结论是根据测试集的点数估计和靴子置信间隔,而不是种子间变异性来制定的. 测试集上的布特斯特拉间隔(表7,9)提供了单个实例层面的统计不确定性估计,但模型初始化层面则没有. 确认质量接近的QLORA配置的差异(例如,YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B 0.736 0.736 相对于表6中的Mistral-7B 0.709 0.709;McNemar p Holm = 0.183 p_{\tex{Holm}}=0.183,表7)需要将种子数量扩大到3个或更多.

blocks.en: 6.2 Multiclass Classification
blocks.zh: 6.2 多类分类

blocks.en: On the multiclass classification task (19 categories, 47.5 % 47.5\,\% of documents in the dominant class), no configuration exceeded a macro-F1 of 0.37 0.37 (Table 8 ). XLM-R did not outperform the majority baseline (accuracy 0.470 0.470 versus 0.470 0.470 , McNemar p = 1.000 p=1.000 ); mBERT outperforms the majority baseline statistically significantly but by a small margin (accuracy 0.498 0.498 versus 0.470 0.470 , Δ = + 0.028 \Delta=+0.028 [ + 0.010 , + 0.047 ] [+0.010,+0.047] , p Holm = 0.006 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.006 ). Both results indicate collapse of the encoder models into the dominant class under standard cross-entropy without weighting. The task remains open: solving it requires a weighted loss function, resampling or a hierarchical classification scheme. The results of the QLoRA models on the multiclass task ( 0.119 0.119 – 0.368 0.368 macro-F1) are interpreted as a lower bound on quality.
blocks.zh: 关于多类分类任务(19类,占主类文件的47.5%/47.5%),没有配置超过0.37 0.37的宏F1(表8). XLM-R没有超过多数基线(精确度0.470 0.470 相对于0.470 0.470,McNemar p = 1.000 p = 1.000 0.000 ); mBERT在统计学上显著地超过了多数基线,但差幅很小(精确度0.498 0.498 相对于0.470 0.470, = + 0.028 + Delta 0.028 [+ 0.010 + 0.047] [+ 0.010 + 0.047],p Holm = 0.006 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.006 ). 两种结果显示编码器模型在标准跨度线下崩溃为主类,没有加权值. 任务仍未完成:解决它需要加权损失函数、重新取样或分级分类办法。 QLORA模型在多级任务上的结果(0.119 0.119 – 0.368 0.368 macro-F1)被解读为质量的下限.

blocks.en: 6.3 Sample and Agreement in Native-Speaker Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.3 土著发言人评价样本和协议

blocks.en: Validation by native Bashkir speakers (Section 4.7 ) was conducted on 100 texts with three annotators. Krippendorff’s agreement lies in the range α = 0.694 \alpha=0.694 – 0.772 0.772 , which exceeds the threshold 0.667 0.667 for acceptable agreement krippendorff2011computing , but does not reach 0.80 0.80 for high agreement. The sample of 100 texts is unbalanced across models ( n = 23 n=23 for the three GPT-2 family models, n = 11 n=11 for Mistral-7B and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, n = 9 n=9 for Phi-3-mini), which limits the power of pairwise comparisons between models of similar quality. In particular, the difference between Mistral-7B ( 2.12 2.12 ) and Phi-3-mini ( 1.81 1.81 ) on grammar does not reach significance after Holm correction ( p Holm > 0.05 p_{\text{Holm}}>0.05 ), although the point difference is 0.31 0.31 points. A final ordering of the medium-scale models requires expanding the annotated sample to ≥ 30 \geq 30 texts per model.
blocks.zh: 由讲巴什基尔语的当地人(第4.7节)对100个文本进行验证,并配有3名注释员。 Krippendorff的协议位于α = 0.694\alpha = 0.694 – 0.772 0.772 之间,超过可接受的协议的阈值 0.667 0.667 计算 krippendorff2011 计算,但高协议没有达到0.80 0.80. 100个文本的样本在模型之间是不平衡的(N=23n=23对3个GPT-2家族模型,n=11n=11对Mistral-7B和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B,n=9n=9对Phi-3-mini),这限制了类似质量模型之间的对等比较力. 特别是,Mistral-7B(2.12 2.12)和Phi-3-mini(1.81 1.81)在语法上的区别在霍尔姆校正(pHolm > 0.05 p_{\text{Holm}}>0.05)之后并不重要,尽管点差是0.31 0.31分. 中尺度模型的最终定型需要将附加说明的样本扩大到每个模型的30 \ eq 30 个文本。

blocks.en: 6.4 Divergence Between LLM-as-Judge and Native Speakers
blocks.zh: 6.4 LLM-as-Judge和土著语使用者之间的差异

blocks.en: The correlation of direct scoring by LLM judges with native-speaker ratings is significant for grammar ( ρ = 0.462 \rho=0.462 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and coherence ( ρ = 0.334 \rho=0.334 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), but does not reach significance for language correctness ( ρ = 0.162 \rho=0.162 , p = 0.11 p=0.11 , Section 4.7 ). LLM judges systematically compress the scale (range of means 1.89 1.89 – 2.89 2.89 versus 1.16 1.16 – 3.82 3.82 for native speakers) and in some cases change the ranking of models (on the language criterion, LLM judges place GPT-2 base above YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, whereas native speakers do the opposite). The pairwise mode of LLM judges yields a ranking opposite to direct scoring and native speakers, which is explained by the absence of length control in the pairs. LLM-as-Judge in the present work is regarded as an additional signal on formal-grammatical aspects, rather than as a replacement for native-speaker evaluation. Training a Bashkir-language LLM judge or explicit length normalisation in the pairwise mode constitute directions for further work.
blocks.zh: LLM评委直接评分与母语评分的关联性对于语法(^ = 0.462\rho=0.462,p < 0.001 p < 0.001)和一致性(^ 0.334\rho=0.334,p < 0.001 p < 0.0001)都很重要,但对语言正确性没有意义(^ = 0.162\rho=0.162,p=0.11 p=0.11,第4.7节). LLM评委系统压缩比额(1.89 1.89 – 2.89 2.89 相对于1.16 1.16 – 3.82 3.82 本地语者),并在某些情况下改变模型的排名(在语言标准上,LLM评委将GPT-2基数置于YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B以上,而本地语者则相反). LLM评委的对等模式得出了与直接评分和母语的对等的排名,其原因是对等中没有长度控制. 目前工作中的LLM-as-Judge被视为关于正式语法方面的额外信号,而不是取代母语评价。 培训一名巴什基尔语的LLM法官或双向的明显长度正常化,是今后工作的方向。

blocks.en: 6.5 Scope of the Tokeniser Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.5 Tokeniser分析的范围

blocks.en: The tokeniser analysis (Section 4.8 ) includes three metrics: fertility rate on Bashkir, English and Turkish; Morphological Boundary Accuracy; OOV rate. MorphAcc remains low for all models ( 0.047 0.047 – 0.093 0.093 ), which limits its discriminative capacity; the relative order by MorphAcc is consistent with the order by downstream quality, but the difference between models by MorphAcc is smaller than by fertility. The relationship between fertility and adaptation quality is correlational on a sample of five models with measured fertility and downstream results (YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, Mistral-7B, GPT-2 base, GPT-2 medium, DistilGPT2); establishing a causal relationship requires experiments with controlled vocabulary modification. The DeepSeek-7B model is excluded from the fertility and MorphAcc analysis because of a fertility rate of 0.331 < 1 0.331<1 , which indicates an artefact of input text normalisation.
blocks.zh: 象征性分析(第4.8节)包括三个衡量标准:Bashkir、英语和土耳其语的生育率;道德边界精确度;OOV率。 所有型号(0.047 0.047 – 0.093 0.093)的莫尔法克仍然很低,这限制了其歧视能力;莫尔法克的相对顺序与下游质量的顺序一致,但莫尔法克的模型之间的差异比生育率小. 生育力和适应质量之间的关系在五个模型的样本上具有相关性,这些模型具有测量的生育力和下游结果(YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B,Mistral-7B,GPT-2碱基,GPT-2介质,DistilGPT2);建立因果关系需要通过控制词汇修改进行实验. DeepSeek-7B模型被排除在生育力和甲状腺素分析之外,因为生育率为0.331 < 1 0.331 < 1,这表明输入文本的动脉正常化。

blocks.en: For fertility rate, the present work reports only point estimates, without confidence intervals. The point estimate was computed as the ratio of the total number of subtokens to the total number of words on the test set ( ∑ tokens / ∑ words \sum\text{tokens}/\sum\text{words} ), whereas bootstrap resampling was based on per-document ratios ( tokens i / words i ¯ \overline{\text{tokens}_{i}/\text{words}_{i}} ). By Jensen’s inequality, the mean of ratios does not coincide with the ratio of sums; therefore a standard percentile-bootstrap CI does not cover the point estimate, and such an interval is incorrect as an estimate of uncertainty for ∑ tokens / ∑ words \sum\text{tokens}/\sum\text{words} . We report only point estimates of fertility and do not use them for statistical inferences about differences between models: downstream metrics and McNemar’s exact test are used as the primary instrument for cross-model comparisons. Bootstrap intervals for fertility are not published in the replication package; the corresponding columns have been removed from the release CSV ( tokenizer_comparison_table_release.csv ).
blocks.zh: 就生育率而言,本工作报告只是点数估计,没有置信间隔。 点估计值是按测试集中子词总数与单词总数的比率( \\ 令牌 /\ sum\ text{ tokens}/\ sum\ text{ text}) 计算的,而靴子复制是基于每份文件的比例( i / words i \ text{ tokens{i}/\ text{words} )。 根据Jensen的不平等,比率的平均值与总和的比率不相吻合;因此标准百分位数-bootstrap CI不包含点数估计,而且这样的间隔是错的,因为对\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 我们只报告生育力的点估计,而不用于对模型之间差异的统计推论:下游的度量衡和麦克尼玛精确的测试被用作跨模型比较的主要工具. 生育力的靴子间隔不公布在复制包中;相应的列已经从发行的CSV中去除(标注器_比较器_table_release.csv).

blocks.en: Language modelling (Section 4.1 ) was conducted with a maximum sequence length of 128 tokens. For documents longer than this threshold, perplexity is computed on truncated sequences, which underestimates PPL for models with a high fertility rate: with fertility 7.80 7.80 (GPT-2 family), a test sequence of 128 tokens covers ∼ \sim 16 Bashkir words, whereas with fertility 3.80 3.80 (YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B) it covers ∼ \sim 34 words. This is precisely why GPT-2 medium shows the lowest PPL ( 2.33 2.33 ) with the worst BPB ( 0.784 0.784 ): PPL is computed on short fragments, where next-token prediction is easier, whereas BPB is normalised by the number of bytes. BPB is used as the primary metric for cross-model comparison; PPL values are reported for completeness and are not interpreted as an indicator of language modelling quality on full documents. Controlled experiments with full document length ( 512 512 or 1024 1024 tokens) constitute a direction for further work.

blocks.en: 6.7 Directions for Further Work

blocks.en: The set of limitations listed above determines five directions for further work. First, expanding the number of random seeds for PEFT experiments to three or more with estimation of between-seed variability. Second, solving the multiclass classification task through a weighted loss function and comparison with hierarchical schemes. Third, expanding the annotated sample for native-speaker validation to ≥ 30 \geq 30 texts per model and training a Bashkir-language LLM judge. Fourth, controlled experiments with vocabulary expansion to test the causal relationship between fertility rate and adaptation quality. Fifth, a systematic investigation of approaches to generation grounded in external sources. Pilot experiments with RAG ( n = 30 n=30 questions, a QLoRA-adapted Mistral-7B as generator, multilingual-e5-large as retriever) and Multi-Agent Debate ( n = 10 n=10 questions, two agents and two rounds) are not included in the main analysis: on a sample of n = 6 n=6 common questions, the paired comparison did not reveal significant differences (faithfulness p boot = 0.056 p_{\text{boot}}=0.056 , answer relevance p boot = 0.912 p_{\text{boot}}=0.912 ), the absolute scores of both approaches remain below the neutral point of the scale (faithfulness 1.80 1.80 – 2.50 2.50 , answer relevance 1.63 1.63 – 2.13 2.13 on a 1–5 scale), and the sample is insufficient for final conclusions. Artefacts of the pilot experiments are available in the repository; a systematic investigation of RAG and MAD on Bashkir with an increased sample and tuning of the retriever component constitutes a separate direction. These directions go beyond the scope of the present work, but follow directly from the results obtained.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: The work presents an open resource suite for the Bashkir language and a systematic benchmark of methods for adapting large language models to a low-resource agglutinative language with Cyrillic script. The main artefacts are the Bashkir Web Corpus (71,567 documents, 46.9 million tokens, 16 sources), three labelled datasets for binary, multiclass and multilabel classification, and trained adapters for all configurations presented in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 这部作品为巴什基尔语提供了一个开放的资源套件,并系统规定了将大型语言模型适应具有西里尔字母的低资源杂质语言的方法基准。 主要的手工艺品是Bashkir Web Corpus(71567份文件,4 690万令牌,16个来源),三套二进制、多级和多标签分类的标签数据集,以及第4节中所有配置的训练有素的适配器。

blocks.en: The experiments were conducted on eight architectures in the 82 82 M– 8 8 B parameter range and three groups of adaptation strategies: full fine-tuning (small models and encoder-only baselines), QLoRA (medium-scale generative models) and in-context learning (zero-shot and few-shot). In addition, the benefit of continual pretraining on the Bashkir corpus as a preliminary stage before QLoRA adaptation was tested.
blocks.zh: 这些实验涉及82 M-8 B参数范围的8个架构和3组适应战略:全面微调(小模型和编码器唯一的基线)、QLORA(中等规模的基因模型)和内文学习(零镜头和几镜头)。 此外,在QLORA调整之前,作为初步阶段,继续就Bashkira案进行预先培训的好处得到了检验。

blocks.en: Four results constitute the main contribution of the work.
blocks.zh: 四项成果是这项工作的主要贡献。

blocks.en: First. QLoRA adaptation of 3.8 3.8 – 8 8 B generative models outperforms full fine-tuning of encoder-only baselines on binary classification: YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B with CPT reaches a macro-F1 of 0.748 0.748 versus 0.653 0.653 for XLM-R and 0.650 0.650 for mBERT, that is, 9.5 9.5 – 9.8 9.8 points higher (Table 6 ); in a pairwise comparison of accuracy for the step6 configurations ( 0.737 0.737 versus 0.659 0.659 and 0.652 0.652 ), the difference between QLoRA adaptation and the encoder-only baseline is significant after Holm correction for 15 pairwise comparisons (McNemar, p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 , Table 7 ). Without CPT the same model shows 0.736 0.736 (step6, r = 8 r=8 ) and 0.748 0.748 (step4, r = 16 r=16 ) — in both cases 8.3 8.3 – 9.8 9.8 points above the encoder baseline.

blocks.en: Second. On binary classification the point advantage of YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( 0.736 0.736 – 0.748 0.748 versus 0.681 0.681 – 0.721 0.721 and 0.674 0.674 – 0.702 0.702 ) is not statistically confirmed within the step6 QLoRA group: Yandex vs Mistral p Holm = 0.183 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.183 , Yandex vs Phi-3 p Holm = 0.084 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.084 (Table 7 ). The only metric on which YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B is significantly inferior to Mistral-7B is the pairwise win rate of LLM judges ( 0.444 0.444 versus 0.529 0.529 ); as shown in Section 5.3 , this discrepancy is explained by the absence of length control in the pairs rather than by model quality. blocks.en: Third. Continual pretraining on 10,000 documents of the Bashkir corpus yields a significant perplexity gain for Phi-3-mini ( Δ = + 0.58 \Delta=+0.58 , p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 , Cliff’s δ \delta large) and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( Δ = + 0.33 \Delta=+0.33 , p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 , Cliff’s δ \delta large), but significantly worsens perplexity for Mistral-7B ( Δ = − 1.15 \Delta=-1.15 , p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 , Cliff’s δ \delta large, negative sign; Table 5 ). The effect of CPT on downstream tasks has a different direction: on binary classification CPT gives the largest gain precisely for Mistral-7B ( + 4.0 +4.0 points of macro-F1); on multiclass classification CPT improves YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( + 0.034 +0.034 ) and Phi-3-mini ( + 0.012 +0.012 ), but worsens Mistral-7B ( − 0.015 -0.015 ). For Mistral-7B the directions of the CPT effect on LM and on binary classification are opposite: perplexity increases by 1.15 1.15 points, while macro-F1 increases by 4.0 4.0 points. This indicates that the benefit of CPT depends on both the base model and the task, and requires separation of the effects of CPT and downstream training for final conclusions.

blocks.en: Fourth. The fertility rate of the tokeniser on Bashkir varies by a factor of 2.67 2.67 — from 2.92 2.92 (T-lite-2.1) to 7.80 7.80 (GPT-2 family and Phi-2; Table 15 ) — and is consistent with the observed adaptation quality: with fertility 7.80 7.80 , GPT-2 family models show BPB 0.784 0.784 – 0.917 0.917 and native-speaker ratings 1.16 1.16 – 1.48 1.48 , whereas YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B ( 3.80 3.80 ) shows BPB 0.462 0.462 and a mean of 3.28 3.28 . Perplexity is misleading: GPT-2 medium shows the lowest PPL ( 2.33 2.33 ) with the worst BPB ( 0.784 0.784 ), which makes BPB the primary metric for cross-model comparison under different tokenisers. The mechanism of this discrepancy is explained in Section 6.5 : when test sequences are truncated to 128 tokens, models with a high fertility rate cover fewer Bashkir words per sequence. Control on Turkish confirms the interpretation: the spread of fertility on Bashkir ( 2.67 2.67 times) exceeds the spread on Turkish ( 1.25 1.25 times) and English ( 1.09 1.09 times), and the ratio fertility ba {}_{\text{ba}} /fertility tr {}_{\text{tr}} ( 2.18 2.18 for GPT-2, 1.28 1.28 for Mistral-7B, 1.18 1.18 for YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B) orders the three models identically to downstream quality on the binary task.
blocks.zh: 第四处. 巴什基尔的标致器的生育率变化系数为2.672.67——从2.922.92(T-lite-2.1)到7.80(GPT-2家族和Phi-2;表15)——并与观察到的适应质量一致:在生育率7.807.80的情况下,GPT-2家族模型显示BPB 0.784 0.784 – 0.917 0.917,母语者评级为1.16 1.16 – 1.48,而当地人则显示为1.48。 YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(3.80 3.80 )显示BPB 0.462 0.462,平均值为3.28 3.28. 困惑是误导:GPT-2介质显示最低的PPL(2.33 2.33 ),最差的BPB(0.784 0.784),这使得BPB成为不同代号下跨模型比较的主要衡量标准. 第6.5节解释了这种差异的机制:当测试序列被缩短到128个令牌时,生育率高的模型覆盖的每个序列的巴什基尔词较少. 对土耳其语的控制证实了这一解释:Bashkir的生育分布(2.672.67倍)超过了土耳其语(1.251.25倍)和英语(1.091.09倍)的生育分布,在二进制任务上,三种模式与下游质量相同。

blocks.en: The set of results leads to four practical recommendations for adapting LLMs to low-resource agglutinative languages with Cyrillic script. Under a limited computational budget, preference should be given to models with a Cyrillic tokeniser and Russian-language pretraining (in the present work, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B), even if they are inferior in the number of parameters. For classification tasks, QLoRA on 3.8 3.8 – 8 8 B models is preferable to full fine-tuning of encoder-only baselines: all QLoRA configurations significantly outperform mBERT, XLM-R and the majority baseline ( p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 on the binary task, Table 7 ). CPT is justified on perplexity for Phi-3-mini and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, but significantly worsens PPL for Mistral-7B ( p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 ); at the same time, on binary classification CPT gives the largest gain precisely for Mistral-7B ( + 4.0 +4.0 points of macro-F1). The choice of CPT configuration should be determined by the task. For assessing generation quality in a low-resource language, direct scoring by LLM judges on the criteria of grammar and coherence reproduces native-speaker ratings with moderate correlation ( ρ = 0.33 \rho=0.33 – 0.46 0.46 ), but not on the criterion of language correctness ( ρ = 0.16 \rho=0.16 , p = 0.11 p=0.11 ); native-speaker evaluation remains necessary.
blocks.zh: 这套结果导致提出了四项实用建议,即将LLMs改编为带有西里尔字母的低资源杂质语言。 在有限的计算预算下,应优先考虑使用西里尔符号器和俄语预训的模型(在本作中,YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B),即使它们在参数数上较低. 对于分类任务,3.8 3.8 – 8 B型号的QLORA比完全微调编码器唯一基线更好:所有QLORA配置都显著超过 mBERT, XLM-R 和大多数基线(pholm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001 关于二进制任务的表7). 对Phi-3-mini和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B来说,CPT是有道理的,但Mistral-7B的PPL(p Holm < 0.001 p_{\text{Holm}}<0.001)明显恶化;同时,关于二进制分类,CPT给Mistral-7B(+4.0+4.0分宏F1)带来的收益最大。 CPT配置的选择应当由任务决定. 为了评估低资源语言的生成质量,LLM评委对语法和一致性标准的直接评分,转载了中度相关联的土语评分(ρ = 0.33\rho=0.33–0.46 0.46),但没有根据语言正确性标准(ρ = 0.16\rho=0.16,p=0.11 p=0.11)进行土语评分;土语评分仍有必要.

blocks.en: The limitations of the present work (a single random seed for PEFT experiments, collapse of encoder-only models on the multiclass task, imbalance of the sample in native-speaker evaluation, the correlational nature of the relationship between fertility and adaptation quality on a sample of five models, and truncation of test sequences to 128 tokens in perplexity estimation) determine the immediate directions for further work: expanding the number of seeds to three or more, a weighted loss function for multiclass classification, expanding the annotated sample to ≥ 30 \geq 30 texts per model and training a Bashkir-language LLM judge, controlled experiments with vocabulary expansion to test the causal relationship between fertility rate and adaptation quality, and perplexity estimation at full document length ( 512 512 or 1024 1024 tokens).
blocks.zh: 目前工作的局限性(用于PEFT实验的单一随机种子,多类任务上编码器专用模型的崩溃,在本土语言评价中样本的不平衡,五个模型样本中生育率和适应质量之间关系的关联性,以及将测试序列缩短到128个符号在复杂度估计中)决定了下一步工作的直接方向:种子数量扩大到三个或三个以上,多类分类的加权损失功能,将附加说明的样本扩大到每个模型30\geq文本,并培训一名Bashkir语言的LLM法官,以词汇扩展测试生育率和适应质量之间的因果关系的控制实验,以及全文件长度的复杂度估计(512 512或1024 1024个符号)。

blocks.en: All artefacts — the corpus, datasets, experiment code, trained adapters and evaluation scripts — are released under open licences ( https://huggingface.co/BashkirNLPWorld/bashkir-nlp-benchmark ). The resource suite and benchmark are intended for further research on adapting large language models to the Bashkir language and to other low-resource agglutinative languages with non-standard script.
blocks.zh: 所有手工艺品——物证、数据集、实验代码、训练有素的适配器和评价脚本——均以开放许可证发放(https://huggingface.co/BashkirNLPWorld/bashkir-nlp-benchmark)。 资源套装和基准旨在进一步研究如何使大型语言模型适应巴什基尔语言和其他资源匮乏的具有非标准脚本的语言。
